nodes.label: The analysis protocol: a day of research with no experiment in it
nodes.norm_label: the analysis protocol: a day of research with no experiment in it
nodes.rationale: One NHL market touched of all asked, sources loaded but unused, classifier metrics instead of units and CLV, and a free SBR archive recorded as a 'fallback' while a 159,900-credit purchase was scheduled.

nodes.label: The At-Most side is missing from the feed, not from the parser
nodes.norm_label: the at-most side is missing from the feed, not from the parser
nodes.rationale: Counts of what our table held answer 'we have no Under', not 'there is no Under'. One-sided is per book and per market; the flag is bool(over) != bool(under), never a ratio.

nodes.label: Our state was behind the book, and every guard passed (BookMoveClock)
nodes.norm_label: our state was behind the book, and every guard passed (bookmoveclock)
nodes.rationale: Delaware ML fired on a 0-0 state 23 s after DraftKings re-hung for a touchdown the CFBD feed had not reported. In 15 of 20 live moneyline bets DK had moved against the side bet. The guard anchors the book's number at the last state change and declines a move past the cap.

nodes.label: Reachability and capability are two measurements
nodes.norm_label: reachability and capability are two measurements
nodes.rationale: Supabase execute_sql answers but is read-only; Railway list-variables answers but redacts values. 'The replay cannot run here' rested on one absent .env key; curl returned 401, so the network was never the blocker.

nodes.label: The current state of a system is not its capability
nodes.norm_label: the current state of a system is not its capability
nodes.rationale: 'Pinnacle history does not exist' was a query against what had been stored; the endpoint had offered it for years. A handover is a last resort; tracking/job_queue.py runs work on the worker instead of ending a turn with a to-do list.

nodes.label: Write-time DDL fires PostgREST schema reloads (ddl_guard)
nodes.norm_label: write-time ddl fires postgrest schema reloads (ddl_guard)
nodes.rationale: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS / ENABLE RLS on every call: 11.6 hours of database time and ~3,600 forced cache reloads; judged per invocation, not per millisecond. Gate ensure blocks on schema_is_current.

nodes.label: A test written from the same understanding that produced the code inherits its blind spot
nodes.norm_label: a test written from the same understanding that produced the code inherits its blind spot
nodes.rationale: Five guards in one day passed while the thing they guarded was broken; each checked the case its author had in mind. Go and look at the running system.

nodes.label: 'Newest row per key' over an append-only log is a writer-maintained state table
nodes.norm_label: 'newest row per key' over an append-only log is a writer-maintained state table
nodes.rationale: Four sessions on the same statement-timeout toast changed how the log was walked; v_latest_dk_odds took 17.9 s and was 189 of 282 timeouts. Fix: current-state tables maintained by triggers (latest_line_state_tables.sql); 17,945 ms -> 2.8 ms.

nodes.label: A live cutoff decays, so re-derive it
nodes.norm_label: a live cutoff decays, so re-derive it
nodes.rationale: First-signal lock plus 5s polling took MLB live from ~35% to 100% of games producing a bet at an unchanged threshold; the meaning of the cut moved.

nodes.label: Live player props: priced relative to the starting line
nodes.norm_label: live player props: priced relative to the starting line
nodes.rationale: The thesis is not beating line movement; the book re-anchors its live line mechanically off the pregame number and the clock, and the edge is predicting where true remaining production deviates from that.

nodes.label: The settled-state rule (LIVE_SETTLED_SEC)
nodes.rationale: Size-of-move guards cannot tell a 30-second-old re-hang from a genuine disagreement once the re-hang is the anchor; no market is priced until book and state have both been still longer than the worst measured lag. MLB excluded because its state feed leads the book.

nodes.label: 'Today' is the wrong question for a live loop (live_slate_dates)
nodes.norm_label: 'today' is the wrong question for a live loop (live_slate_dates)
nodes.rationale: A game carries the game_date of its first pitch; the loop went dark at midnight ET for the last 77 minutes of three West Coast games. 'No active games' looks identical to an empty slate, so the guard is a test.

nodes.label: The MCP 'requires authentication' banner is not evidence
nodes.norm_label: the mcp 'requires authentication' banner is not evidence
nodes.rationale: The tools are claude.ai connectors authorized on the account; the local startup check cannot see that credential and reports 'not authorized' for a server that is.

nodes.label: Every model carries its own EV floor
nodes.norm_label: every model carries its own ev floor
nodes.rationale: GLOBAL_MIN_EV at 0.20 deleted every bet mlb_spread_market and mlb_total_public_fade had written with no row to say so. Each floor sits just under the model's smallest written bet, three deliberate departures floored at 0.00.

nodes.label: Never estimate what you can measure
nodes.norm_label: never estimate what you can measure
nodes.rationale: Five wrong answers in one session shared one cause: reaching for the familiar shape of the task instead of the facts in hand. A time estimate, a number and a test each produced a real wrong answer on 2026-08-30; a test is not finished until it has been watched to fail.

nodes.label: A change to how one model operates is assessed against all of them
nodes.norm_label: a change to how one model operates is assessed against all of them
nodes.rationale: The live price log existed for MLB and not NCAAF; the first-signal lock for NFL and nowhere else. Prefer a sport-agnostic helper the loops call. Applies to mechanics, never to cuts.

nodes.label: A pause erased 55 settled NCAAF bets from the published record
nodes.norm_label: a pause erased 55 settled ncaaf bets from the published record
nodes.rationale: Every published-record surface filtered on t.paused; one query answering both 'may bet next' and 'did bet' moved the number. Across 13 paused models the flag hid 1,461 settled BETs. The pause itself was Claude's escalation stamped with mike's name.

nodes.label: A pick stamped after its own first pitch is not a pre-game pick
nodes.norm_label: a pick stamped after its own first pitch is not a pre-game pick
nodes.rationale: 1,046 of 1,249 unmeasured MLB/WNBA prop bets carried created_at after commence_time; without the bound they would have received fabricated beat-the-close verdicts.

nodes.label: The ledger cannot prevent a duplicate, only record one (publish_lock)
nodes.norm_label: the ledger cannot prevent a duplicate, only record one (publish_lock)
nodes.rationale: Two services ran read -> post -> ledger 252 ms apart; the fix is a Postgres advisory lock taken by all three publishers, applied to push as well as Discord.

nodes.label: A pick is quoted from its label, never rebuilt from its line
nodes.norm_label: a pick is quoted from its label, never rebuilt from its line
nodes.rationale: 'BUF +1' (scored_line -1.0, the home number) was relayed as 'Bills -1' and published. tracking/pick_integrity.py refuses any pick whose label disagrees with side and line on all eight send paths.

nodes.label: The app, Discord and push show the same picks
nodes.norm_label: the app, discord and push show the same picks
nodes.rationale: Publishers read opening_signals while the app read picks; every miss was a capture miss (6 of 125) and delivery was already 100%. NFL_LOCK_AHEAD_DAYS=7 vs a 9-day-out game produced no lock row.

nodes.label: Sandbox limits are not the system's limits (four routes)
nodes.norm_label: sandbox limits are not the system's limits (four routes)
nodes.rationale: Vendor pricing was reported as uncheckable while holding WebSearch. Four routes reach anything: WebSearch/WebFetch, the Railway worker (open egress, holds the keys), Matt's machine, the Supabase MCP (read-only).

nodes.label: Say each thing once
nodes.rationale: 13 replies each put 1,200-1,900 characters above the four headings and then recapped them; open items were re-listed across 8 of 13 replies.

nodes.label: Session summaries go to docs/sessions, not CLAUDE.md
nodes.norm_label: session summaries go to docs/sessions, not claude.md
nodes.rationale: 'Update CLAUDE.md after every commit' grew it to 909 KB (~225k tokens re-read every session), 76% a log duplicating git history.

nodes.label: A write-time gate changes tomorrow's board; the standing board is held to it by hand
nodes.norm_label: a write-time gate changes tomorrow's board; the standing board is held to it by hand
nodes.rationale: 51 standing BETs on unstarted games were all under the new 0.30 EV floor and were voided the same hour.

nodes.label: An ungraded reference (Kalshi ladder) wrote 25 bets in one pass
nodes.norm_label: an ungraded reference (kalshi ladder) wrote 25 bets in one pass
nodes.rationale: A reference is part of the model; interpolating a thin Kalshi ladder across ten yards produced 95% unders. NFL_PROP_MARKET_KALSHI_REFERENCE defaults off.

nodes.label: Updated-By git trailer on every model update
nodes.norm_label: updated-by git trailer on every model update
nodes.rationale: Two people direct the work; six months later 'why is this model paused?' is unanswerable without the name. The trailer goes on the branch commit so it survives the squash-merge.

nodes.label: Validate the grading before moving a cut
nodes.norm_label: validate the grading before moving a cut
nodes.rationale: A sign bug in away-side spread grading (+scored_line instead of -) turned a -20.6% cut into a phantom +15%.

nodes.label: A pick the model should never have produced is voided, never deleted
nodes.norm_label: a pick the model should never have produced is voided, never deleted
nodes.rationale: The deleted row is also the evidence the bug happened. scripts/void_picks.py sets result NO_ACTION and condition_status VOID, keeps created_at/line/price/lock, and refuses a graded pick.

nodes.label: Live feature sensitivity (12.8pp median swing)
nodes.community_name: Probability calibration and in-play cut replays
nodes.rationale: Varying only which day's season-to-date stats snapshot feeds the row moves p_over by a median 0.128 across 60 live BETs, comparable to the whole decision margin. The in-process feature cache froze an unrecorded snapshot per game, which is why picks could not be reproduced.

nodes.norm_label: ingestorchestrator: per-source fetch with no silent fallbacks

nodes.label: Moneyline derived from spread via fitted sigmoid
nodes.norm_label: moneyline derived from spread via fitted sigmoid
nodes.rationale: Training a separate classifier would waste data and risk calibration divergence; sigmoid slope is shallower in adverse weather.

nodes.label: Live candidate: precip > 0.2mm AND wind < 11 -> under
nodes.norm_label: live candidate: precip > 0.2mm and wind < 11 -> under
nodes.rationale: n=114, 58.77% under, CI [50.0, 67.5], zero overlap with wind by construction; threshold chosen after looking, measured on ERA5 truth not forecast.

nodes.label: Rejected candidates (backup QB lookahead artifact, home dogs, cold unders reversed, refs, rest...)
nodes.norm_label: rejected candidates (backup qb lookahead artifact, home dogs, cold unders reversed, refs, rest...)

nodes.label: RetrainTrigger: preseason, week 9, CLV < -0.3, calibration drift > 0.08
nodes.norm_label: retraintrigger: preseason, week 9, clv < -0.3, calibration drift > 0.08

nodes.label: SHAP: feature validation, bet auditing, feature selection
nodes.norm_label: shap: feature validation, bet auditing, feature selection

nodes.label: Spread model: LightGBM + Ridge meta-learner on margin
nodes.norm_label: spread model: lightgbm + ridge meta-learner on margin
nodes.rationale: The anchor; its output feeds the moneyline derivation and the totals model.

nodes.label: SpreadEnsemble: 5 diversified LightGBM base models + Ridge
nodes.norm_label: spreadensemble: 5 diversified lightgbm base models + ridge

nodes.label: Monitor: slope of closing total against forecast wind, season by season
nodes.norm_label: monitor: slope of closing total against forecast wind, season by season
nodes.rationale: If the market's captured share rises from ~40% the edge is closing and the rule should be retired rather than re-tuned.

nodes.label: Wind totals rule: outdoor, forecast >= 11 (Open-Meteo scale), bet the UNDER
nodes.norm_label: wind totals rule: outdoor, forecast >= 11 (open-meteo scale), bet the under
nodes.rationale: Frozen on 1999-2015, tested 2016-2025: 58.09% under at >= 12 (n=408). Dose-response is monotonic, the signature of a real effect.

nodes.label: NFL Game Lines Model System (canonical write-up)
nodes.norm_label: nfl game lines model system (canonical write-up)

nodes.label: Adverse selection in best-EV book selection
nodes.norm_label: adverse selection in best-ev book selection
nodes.rationale: Selecting the max EV across ~44 book-side combinations selects the quotes where our truth estimate is most wrong; largely an artifact of sign-flipped quotes.

nodes.label: The one confirmed lever: price (median best -104)
nodes.norm_label: the one confirmed lever: price (median best -104)
nodes.rationale: Taking the best price hands over 1.4 points of win rate for free; it halves the hurdle but a random side at -104 still returns ~-1.9%.

nodes.label: CLV is the primary success metric, not win rate
nodes.norm_label: clv is the primary success metric, not win rate
nodes.rationale: Detecting a 3% edge at 80% power needs ~2,178 bets (~16 seasons); CLV is measurable per bet at far lower variance.

nodes.label: Continuous wind: dose-response real, extra volume not bettable
nodes.norm_label: continuous wind: dose-response real, extra volume not bettable
nodes.rationale: The 8-11 band sits at 53.58% against 52.38% breakeven; the tradeable region really is 11+.

nodes.label: Efficiency wall: game lines near breakeven
nodes.norm_label: efficiency wall: game lines near breakeven
nodes.rationale: Initially read as 'abandon game lines'; withdrawn after the sign-flip screen moved the oracle ceiling from +3.38% to +8.07% and realistic strategies to roughly breakeven.

nodes.label: The rule survives on ERA5, an independent wind source
nodes.norm_label: the rule survives on era5, an independent wind source
nodes.rationale: nflverse and ERA5 correlate 0.688 and agree on the >= 12 flag 85.8% of the time, yet ERA5-only games hit 62.1%: the effect is physical wind, not a data artifact.

nodes.label: Sign warning: apply E[truth | forecast], not E[forecast - truth | truth]
nodes.norm_label: sign warning: apply e[truth | forecast], not e[forecast - truth | truth]
nodes.rationale: At lead 3 a 12-14 mph forecast corresponds to 10.7 mph actual; getting this backwards fires the rule on far too many games.

nodes.label: Forecast wind at kickoff hour, not a game-window mean
nodes.norm_label: forecast wind at kickoff hour, not a game-window mean
nodes.rationale: Kickoff hour correlates 0.771 with observed wind vs 0.730 for the 4-hour mean; the rule scores 59.32% vs 57.88%.

nodes.label: Line shopping is load-bearing
nodes.rationale: Execution CLV at DraftKings alone is +0.012 (t=0.26); the identical model across the full book set returns +0.321. The entire edge lives between the best number and the Pinnacle close.

nodes.label: The market captures ~40% of the true wind effect
nodes.norm_label: the market captures ~40% of the true wind effect
nodes.rationale: Total moves 43.42 -> 40.85 (2.6 pts) across the wind range while actual scoring falls 6.2.

nodes.label: The signal is market microstructure, not fundamentals
nodes.norm_label: the signal is market microstructure, not fundamentals
nodes.rationale: 21 microstructure features give CLV +0.368; 116 fundamentals alone give -0.019 on 27 bets. Dominant feature is pin_vs_consensus; the PFF ingestion layer should be re-justified before it is built.

nodes.label: Optuna tuned per walk-forward split, median hyperparameters
nodes.norm_label: optuna tuned per walk-forward split, median hyperparameters
nodes.rationale: Guards against hyperparameters that overfit one season's validation set.

nodes.label: Points-to-vig arithmetic: ~0.8 points of CLV to break even at -110
nodes.norm_label: points-to-vig arithmetic: ~0.8 points of clv to break even at -110
nodes.rationale: A spread point is worth ~3% of win probability away from key numbers; +0.449 CLV is significant and still not enough, which reconciles positive CLV with 50.1% ATS.

nodes.label: Ridge as meta-learner
nodes.rationale: Low variance is critical when stacking only 5 base models; a non-linear meta-learner would overfit and Ridge weights are interpretable.

nodes.label: Shrinkage-calibrated meta-learner: pred = mu + beta*(blend - mu), beta in [0,1]
nodes.norm_label: shrinkage-calibrated meta-learner: pred = mu + beta*(blend - mu), beta in [0,1]
nodes.rationale: Bounding beta guarantees the ensemble can never be more aggressive than its own base blend; fixes the earlier miscalibration from unconstrained OLS on five collinear predictions.

nodes.label: Sign convention locked: spread = expected home margin (nflverse orientation)
nodes.norm_label: sign convention locked: spread = expected home margin (nflverse orientation)
nodes.rationale: The Odds API quotes the home handicap (negative = home favoured); spread = -point_home. clv_home = closing - bet; clv_away = bet - closing.

nodes.label: Walk-forward validation with two-season holdout
nodes.rationale: NFL has ~285 games a season; a random split leaks temporal patterns (line trends, rule changes, roster evolution).

nodes.label: Weather-bucket stratification of the sigmoid
nodes.rationale: In adverse weather outcome variance rises, so a 3-point favourite wins less often; k ~0.17 dome, 0.15 normal, 0.12 adverse.

nodes.label: check_feed_assumptions: automatic first-payload feed check
nodes.rationale: A one-time manual blessing goes stale the moment it passes, and the failure is silent: a payload with one field renamed prices every game off a default.

nodes.label: Gate 1: win probability Brier 0.1654 PASS vs 0.20
nodes.norm_label: gate 1: win probability brier 0.1654 pass vs 0.20

nodes.label: Gate 2: total quantile coverage 1.26pp PASS vs 2.0pp
nodes.norm_label: gate 2: total quantile coverage 1.26pp pass vs 2.0pp
nodes.rationale: Passes on the point estimate but the interval reaches 4.95pp, so without margin to spare.

nodes.label: DK live pass-attempts line sits ~2.33 attempts low
nodes.norm_label: dk live pass-attempts line sits ~2.33 attempts low
nodes.rationale: Three seasons, one sign, one magnitude, one market; 64.2% of 2025 finals cleared the line. The model is not a sharper forecaster, it is a better centred one. Consistent with +0.29 on completions because late passing volume arrives at a low completion rate.

nodes.label: Projection-based prop engine fails all 7 markets
nodes.norm_label: projection-based prop engine fails all 7 markets
nodes.rationale: Every market over-projects and every distribution is too narrow: the opportunity model is structurally wrong, not a constant to tune. Two silent bugs (GAME vs TEAM plays denominator; run-pass split applied twice) were invisible to sixteen unit tests.

nodes.label: engine/prop_flow.py: live props priced relative to the starting line
nodes.norm_label: engine/prop_flow.py: live props priced relative to the starting line
nodes.rationale: A book re-anchors its live prop mechanically off its opener and the clock; the edge is knowing where that re-anchoring is wrong. Rebuilding a projection from scratch and discarding the pregame line failed every gate.

nodes.label: Pseudo-CLV is the spec's gate, not ROI
nodes.norm_label: pseudo-clv is the spec's gate, not roi
nodes.rationale: A later quote on the same player at the same book prices the identical proposition on a better informed view; 'pseudo' because the true close is the whistle.

nodes.label: pull_prop_snaps: measures cost per call from headers, stops at budget
nodes.norm_label: pull_prop_snaps: measures cost per call from headers, stops at budget
nodes.rationale: Refuses to run until a probe has established the per-call cost rather than trusting the documented formula.

nodes.label: pricing.anchor_to_market: the live main line is truth
nodes.norm_label: pricing.anchor_to_market: the live main line is truth
nodes.rationale: Without recalibrating onto the devigged market moneyline and total, every derivative edge is contaminated by disagreement with the sharpest number on the board: a wrong model with extra steps.

nodes.label: Intervals are a cluster bootstrap over games, not states
nodes.norm_label: intervals are a cluster bootstrap over games, not states
nodes.rationale: A game contributes a dozen correlated rows, so a naive standard error understates the noise badly.

nodes.label: The control arm: headline hit rates are not the edge
nodes.norm_label: the control arm: headline hit rates are not the edge
nodes.rationale: A model given only anchor-equivalent features already beats the reconstructed anchor by learning a better prorate; the defensible quantity is full minus control.

nodes.label: Credits are not a constraint (4.48M of 5M remaining)
nodes.norm_label: credits are not a constraint (4.48m of 5m remaining)
nodes.rationale: An earlier version called the pull unaffordable from a stale 20k-quota comment in data_ingest/odds_api.py instead of the live telemetry.

nodes.label: Every pass is recorded, not just every bet
nodes.norm_label: every pass is recorded, not just every bet
nodes.rationale: Without passes there is no way to tell whether a lane produced no bets because there was no edge or because a guard was silently eating every candidate.

nodes.label: Persistence gate cleared, executability gate not
nodes.norm_label: persistence gate cleared, executability gate not
nodes.rationale: 5-minute snapshots, DK suspends props at the snap, and a 91% over book is the fastest way to get limited; thin market, small limits. Phase 5 scoring at in-play cadence, not live money.

nodes.label: 5-minute snapshots make reported ROI an upper bound
nodes.norm_label: 5-minute snapshots make reported roi an upper bound

nodes.label: Puller defaults to the halftime window
nodes.norm_label: puller defaults to the halftime window
nodes.rationale: Halftime is where the highest value lane lives and the market is open with no plays running; two seasons of 2H-only is ~15,400 credits.

nodes.label: Kill criterion: a market must hold over two seasons
nodes.norm_label: kill criterion: a market must hold over two seasons
nodes.rationale: Pre-committed in harness.kill_verdict as code so it cannot be relitigated after looking at the numbers. completions flipped +8.60% to -12.12%; receptions negative both; rush attempts cut as a flow lane because the control was as good.

nodes.label: Alignment is one-directional (latest state at or before the snapshot)
nodes.norm_label: alignment is one-directional (latest state at or before the snapshot)

nodes.label: Overtime is declined, not guessed
nodes.rationale: Sudden-death shaped; pricing with a regulation distribution would be wrong rather than approximate.

nodes.label: Quarter markets approximate and off by default
nodes.norm_label: quarter markets approximate and off by default
nodes.rationale: The engine models points remaining to game end; price_quarter returns approx=True.

nodes.label: Randomised PIT, not midpoint PIT, is the coverage test
nodes.norm_label: randomised pit, not midpoint pit, is the coverage test
nodes.rationale: Midpoint PIT is not uniform under a discrete distribution and manufactured an apparent late-game failure; the midpoint figure is printed alongside so the artifact stays visible.

nodes.label: Stage 2 rebuilt as an empirical pmf conditioned on the predicted mean
nodes.norm_label: stage 2 rebuilt as an empirical pmf conditioned on the predicted mean
nodes.rationale: With two minutes left a team scores zero more points 77.5% of the time; an additive residual on a mean cannot span that atom and failed coverage at 29pp in the final two minutes.

nodes.label: Stage 2 fitted on walk-forward out-of-sample Stage 1 predictions
nodes.norm_label: stage 2 fitted on walk-forward out-of-sample stage 1 predictions
nodes.rationale: On in-sample predictions the spread of actual-given-predicted is too tight, so every derivative looks more certain than it is and appears to have an edge.

nodes.label: 15% of play timestamps discarded by pandas format inference
nodes.norm_label: 15% of play timestamps discarded by pandas format inference
nodes.rationale: nflverse mixes whole-second and fractional-second ISO strings; inferring from the first value turned the rest to NaT and forward-filled them, placing Q3 plays before a halftime snapshot. Fixed with format='ISO8601'.

nodes.label: PREGAME_PRICE_MAX_AGE_MIN (180 min) on game-market reads
nodes.rationale: The lag check drops nothing when every book stops at once, which is how 31 NCAAF games were priced on September lines.

nodes.label: Pruner keeps the opener AND the close per (proposition, book)
nodes.norm_label: pruner keeps the opener and the close per (proposition, book)
nodes.rationale: The opener alone cannot reconstruct a decision-time price; raising PRUNE_NON_DK_KEEP_DAYS wholesale was a ~19 GB commitment. Measured +6 MB/day.

nodes.label: clv_method = standard_v2 (PEDIGREE_CLV_METHODS)
nodes.rationale: Older stamps (no_vig, zero_vig, raw_one_way, raw_one_sided, graded_at_dk_legacy) stay on the row until rewritten and are excluded from averages.

nodes.label: clv_standard_v2_2026_10_14.sql bulk rewrite
nodes.rationale: Recomputes every priced pre-game BET not yet standard_v2; an unmeasurable row older than six hours is stamped with NULLs so the old number leaves the average.

nodes.label: Secondary — market edge vs Pinnacle's fair close (market_clv_*)
nodes.norm_label: secondary — market edge vs pinnacle's fair close (market_clv_*)
nodes.rationale: Power de-vig of Pinnacle's pre-start close (power_3way with a draw; zero_vig for Kalshi/Polymarket). Missing Pinnacle -> NULL. Not the headline beat rate.

nodes.label: Power de-vig (bisection, 80 steps, k in [0.05, 12])
nodes.rationale: Not the multiplicative de-vig in the OddsShopper write-up, so the Dodgers fair here is -143 not -141.

nodes.label: Primary CLV — same-book raw price (clv_pct, clv_pp, clv_beat_close)
nodes.norm_label: primary clv — same-book raw price (clv_pct, clv_pp, clv_beat_close)
nodes.rationale: Did the book we actually bet close worse than the price we took, same side, same line? Neither side de-vigged; equal prices are 0 and not a beat; no other book is filled in.

nodes.label: Same line, and the close bound
nodes.norm_label: same line, and the close bound
nodes.rationale: Filtered to the signed scored_line; bound is the earlier of games.commence_time and picks.game_time; game rows snapshot_type <> in_play; no post-pitch fallback.

nodes.label: Which price is the bet — _bet_price_and_book and clv_bet_book
nodes.norm_label: which price is the bet — _bet_price_and_book and clv_bet_book
nodes.rationale: COALESCE(decision_odds, dk_odds); book is decision_book, else the label's book for the four label-priced models, else DraftKings. The app prints the same via clvBet.ts.

nodes.label: Odds retention — non-DK rows pruned in two tiers, DK and sbr_consensus never
nodes.norm_label: odds retention — non-dk rows pruned in two tiers, dk and sbr_consensus never
nodes.rationale: Non-DK history was written once and never read (~2.7 GB/month at 5 books against a ~2 GB database). Keyed on the game's date, not the snapshot's. Pruned history is gone permanently.

nodes.label: CLV at the price taken — decided and built 2026-10-08
nodes.norm_label: clv at the price taken — decided and built 2026-10-08
nodes.rationale: paper_tracker._bet_price_and_book, picks.clv_bet_book, the graded_at_dk_legacy recompute; only the bet side moved.

nodes.label: Doubleheaders collide under one game_id
nodes.rationale: MLB_<date>_<away>_<home> throws away the Odds API event id; the collision duplicated picks (contained by uq_picks_one_row_per_pick) and can still grade game 2's pick on game 1's score.

nodes.label: era_last3 is the mean of three season-to-date rates, not a rolling ERA
nodes.norm_label: era_last3 is the mean of three season-to-date rates, not a rolling era
nodes.rationale: The rebuild replicates it on purpose; a truer statistic would silently redefine ~21% of mlb_f5_moneyline's importance, so it is a model update with an owner.

nodes.label: games.first_pitch_at — the real first pitch is ~16-20 minutes before commence_time
nodes.norm_label: games.first_pitch_at — the real first pitch is ~16-20 minutes before commence_time
nodes.rationale: Live state goes Live 19.5 minutes before commence_time on average, so snapshot_at <= commence_time leaks in the permissive direction; derived from live_game_state and preferred via COALESCE. Not filled since 2026-08-31.

nodes.label: The pre-game line poller deletes a game's non-BET PROP picks
nodes.norm_label: the pre-game line poller deletes a game's non-bet prop picks
nodes.rationale: The game scorer's housekeeping delete is scoped by game_id not model; stopping the delete alone would leave dead-zone players locked forever. Locking props on BET only is a model update.

nodes.label: mlb_prop_batter_hits paused: dormant since 2026-07-23 and losing when it fires
nodes.norm_label: mlb_prop_batter_hits paused: dormant since 2026-07-23 and losing when it fires
nodes.rationale: Predictions compressed on an unchanged artifact; the -140 floor kept the worse half (-21.2%). Unpause path is a retrain after finding the 07-23 cause.

nodes.label: NCAAF picks scored from prices more than a week old — fixed via PREGAME_PRICE_MAX_AGE_MIN
nodes.norm_label: ncaaf picks scored from prices more than a week old — fixed via pregame_price_max_age_min
nodes.rationale: 200 of 682 pre-game NCAAF picks stood on DK prices from 09-04..09-06 after the feed stopped listing 31 games; the odds step failed every pass 09-27..10-01 while scoring reported success.

nodes.label: [needs-decision] convention
nodes.rationale: Blocked on a human by definition; tick with [x], leave in place a week, then delete.

nodes.label: The odds pruner fails every night, and fixing it as written would break CLV
nodes.norm_label: the odds pruner fails every night, and fixing it as written would break clv
nodes.rationale: Statement timeout since early September; the pruner keeps first and last non-DK rows, but CLV at the price taken needs the row at the pick's created_at and NHL in-play rows are stored as open.

nodes.label: UFC writes one fight under two games rows and a model can bet both
nodes.norm_label: ufc writes one fight under two games rows and a model can bet both
nodes.rationale: 78 pairs since June; the odds feed's id flips on home fighter. _ufc_one_id_per_fight scores one id per pass; fix at the source is one id per fight, sorted fighters, Eastern date.

nodes.label: CLV is not in-play (is_live IS NOT TRUE)
nodes.norm_label: clv is not in-play (is_live is not true)
nodes.rationale: No unbounded latest snapshot; a missing bet-book close is NULL, not DraftKings and not Pinnacle. It grades the process, not P&L, thresholds or pauses.

nodes.label: The backlog file is the memory
nodes.norm_label: the backlog file is the memory
nodes.rationale: A task list that lives only in a chat is gone when the session ends; four fixes were flagged in three sessions and never done. The agent was only ever one reader of it; the reasoning is unchanged by Janitor's retirement.

nodes.label: There is no live CLV
nodes.rationale: Over-plus-line-rose wins 84%, Under-plus-line-rose wins 0%: in-play movement is a partial readout of the outcome, perfectly confounded with it, not a market signal.

nodes.label: Accrued carries from ESPN core leaders
nodes.norm_label: accrued carries from espn core leaders
nodes.rationale: Core's competition leaders document covers 96.3% of listed rush-attempt props; a miss is safe because a player with no accrued count is declined, never priced at the wrong number.

nodes.label: rush_attempt_pace model: one offset on the book's number
nodes.norm_label: rush_attempt_pace model: one offset on the book's number
nodes.rationale: Inside the selected population neither surge size nor price is significant, so the model is logit P(under) = logit(book de-vigged under) + delta; delta measures 0.3655 (CI 0.229-0.502) and deploys at 0.25, a haircut just above the lower bound. It has one degree of freedom rather than six because the fitted six-feature version did not replicate on 2024.

nodes.label: Book roles: fetched (LINE_SHOP_BOOKMAKERS) vs offered (BEST_LINE_BOOKMAKERS)
nodes.rationale: Caesars is williamhill_us; wynnbet does not exist on the feed; espnbet still prices but is excluded by mike's call.

nodes.label: DECIDE_ON_BEST_PRICE=0 restores DraftKings as the deciding price
nodes.norm_label: decide_on_best_price=0 restores draftkings as the deciding price

nodes.label: Stage 2: decide, size and settle at the best price (picks.decision_*)
nodes.norm_label: stage 2: decide, size and settle at the best price (picks.decision_*)
nodes.rationale: Every cut was swept on DK-implied edge, so the flip loosens each by 0.68pp on average (3.61pp max) with nobody deciding to; mike: 'remove DK only - we want best lines regardless', Updated-By: mike. Pre-flip rows COALESCE to dk_*.

nodes.label: _get_event_odds fetched DraftKings-only (MLB F5, UFC round totals)
nodes.norm_label: _get_event_odds fetched draftkings-only (mlb f5, ufc round totals)
nodes.rationale: The only route for the two 'additional markets'; 51 of 176 MLB pre-game BETs had nothing to shop against. Fixed to take bookmakers=ODDS_API_BOOKMAKERS_PARAM with a 400 fallback.

nodes.label: The live models join best-price deciding (2026-09-10)
nodes.norm_label: the live models join best-price deciding (2026-09-10)
nodes.rationale: MLB _make_live_pick and NCAAF LiveEngine._deciding decide at the best bettable in-play quote at the same line; every candidate quote passes the same age and score-change gates. nfl_live_prop cannot join: DK-only feed.

nodes.label: Scoring off another book's line (picks.line_book)
nodes.rationale: A proposition DraftKings does not list is lined by the first bettable book in BEST_LINE_BOOKMAKERS order, never by price: the line is the proposition, picking the softest number would choose the bet to suit the model. These picks are a new population; report them separately.

nodes.label: BEST_LINE_EXCLUDE_BOOKMAKERS — unbettable books out of shopping
nodes.norm_label: best_line_exclude_bookmakers — unbettable books out of shopping
nodes.rationale: Pinnacle takes no US customers and Bovada is offshore; 18 of 35 non-DK 'best prices' (26% of bets) pointed at a price the bettor could not take. Kept in the feed for analysis.

nodes.label: BookMark.tsx / BOOK_GLYPHS registry
nodes.rationale: Every pill reads through one registry; a mark must take the pill's foreground colour and be silent for VoiceOver.

nodes.label: Caesars is williamhill_us on The Odds API
nodes.norm_label: caesars is williamhill_us on the odds api
nodes.rationale: Confirm keys against the live API before changing the list; the ingestor only stores what the API returns.

nodes.label: LINE_SHOP_BOOKMAKERS -> ODDS_API_BOOKMAKERS_PARAM
nodes.rationale: Env-overridable; the bookmakers param counts as one region so extra books in the same region cost zero credits.

nodes.label: Line shopping coverage, measured 2026-08-30
nodes.rationale: Pre-game 100% of BETs from 08-29; live wired 08-30 after 0 of 107 August live BETs carried a best price while six books had in-play rows. Any coverage number spanning 08-25 is meaningless.

nodes.label: LIVE_ODDS_MAX_AGE_SEC: 90 -> 60, not 30
nodes.rationale: Wrong-line rate climbs with age (4.8% at 0-15s to 20.5% at 60s+); 30 sat below DK's 47s median republish and declined ~60% of passes. A bound tighter than the feed it guards is an outage, not a safety net.

nodes.label: Three config homes: Railway Variables, config.py -> Supabase, local .env
nodes.norm_label: three config homes: railway variables, config.py -> supabase, local .env
nodes.rationale: Secrets live in Railway (effective only on redeploy); thresholds are canonical in config.py and mirrored; a table edit by hand is temporary.

nodes.label: data.threshold_sync -> model_action_thresholds
nodes.rationale: Runs every refresh pass, daily Step 0c2, and before a Discord post; a 6am-only sync left Discord a day behind the scorer after #727. The app, Discord, push and record views read the table.

nodes.label: Batter props never get a best price stamped
nodes.norm_label: batter props never get a best price stamped
nodes.rationale: 0 August batter-prop BETs carry best_odds while 97% of DK quotes have a same-line match elsewhere; hypothesis: the prop lock freezes a pick written before stamping shipped.

nodes.label: A live pick is decided at the best bettable in-play price at DraftKings' line
nodes.norm_label: a live pick is decided at the best bettable in-play price at draftkings' line
nodes.rationale: dk_odds stays the reference; decision_* say which price the call, stake and settlement used; every candidate quote passes the same age and score gates.

nodes.label: Sportsbook logos in the line pills
nodes.norm_label: sportsbook logos in the line pills

nodes.label: The per-event endpoint bills per market RETURNED
nodes.norm_label: the per-event endpoint bills per market returned
nodes.rationale: Measured with x-requests-last: widening F5 to seven books returns three markets and costs 3 credits, not 1. ~+30/day. The one-region rule is measured, not quoted.

nodes.label: Same line only — a better price on Over 9.0 is not a better price on Over 8.5
nodes.norm_label: same line only — a better price on over 9.0 is not a better price on over 8.5
nodes.rationale: The model probability was computed at the scored line; line-aware shopping means re-scoring, which is separate work. No backfill of best_* onto locked picks (timing is data).

nodes.label: us2 books double the credit cost
nodes.norm_label: us2 books double the credit cost
nodes.rationale: The Odds API bills markets x REGIONS: 8 books 3 credits, 5 us2 books 3, all 13 together 6. Marginal cost of books 2-5 is zero, so it is all-or-nothing.

nodes.label: The affiliate brand kit is the licensed source
nodes.norm_label: the affiliate brand kit is the licensed source
nodes.rationale: A scrape gives the same pixels without the licence; the kit will not go stale on a rebrand.

nodes.label: Why the label ships before the logo
nodes.norm_label: why the label ships before the logo
nodes.rationale: The sandbox cannot reach any image host (CONNECT 403, EGRESS_BLOCKED, no npm icon set); a label names the book correctly and does not lie.

nodes.label: A bad book key must never cost us a fetch (422 -> DK-only retry)
nodes.norm_label: a bad book key must never cost us a fetch (422 -> dk-only retry)
nodes.rationale: One unsupported param value 422s the whole request; adding a book is therefore safe to try.

nodes.label: A frozen book must not win
nodes.norm_label: a frozen book must not win
nodes.rationale: A book that stopped updating still shows its old, better number and a naive max() takes it because it froze; each quote counts only while its own snapshot_at is within LIVE_ODDS_MAX_AGE_SEC, failing open on an unparseable stamp.

nodes.label: The producers in tracking/discord_notifier.py
nodes.rationale: notify_discord_signals, _live, _results, _free_pick, _restate, and the worker job _job_publish_discord_signals.

nodes.label: notify_discord_void / push_sent kind discord_void
nodes.rationale: One gray embed per sport for already-posted VOIDs; v_discord_published drops the lock only while the notice is strictly newer. The original message is never edited or deleted.

nodes.label: Live MLB is one model and the loop runs at 5s
nodes.norm_label: live mlb is one model and the loop runs at 5s
nodes.rationale: Totals re-cut to 0.68/0.14 on a plateau; the two binary models were overconfident at every cut. Pre-game features cached per game; a lane is rewritten only when the proposition changed (_lane_signature).

nodes.label: Live picks go to their sport's live channel (_live_webhook_for_sport)
nodes.norm_label: live picks go to their sport's live channel (_live_webhook_for_sport)
nodes.rationale: Set on BOTH worker and pollers; the discord_probe job reports a live webhook pasted from the pre-game channel as a collision.

nodes.label: post_missed_recap from 7am ET on every refresh pass
nodes.norm_label: post_missed_recap from 7am et on every refresh pass
nodes.rationale: A day the 6am run could not recap posts at the first pass that can; the ledger row commits the moment the post is delivered, BEFORE the snapshot, because a failed snapshot once rolled the ledger back and re-posted every pass.

nodes.label: posted <time ET> = picks.created_at
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT opening_signals.locked_at, which lagged the pick's write by 28 minutes on average and up to 6.4 hours.

nodes.label: publish_discord_signals worker job
nodes.rationale: Nothing is bypassed: it calls the ordinary producer so the started-game guard, cut and ledger apply; a producer invoked by exactly one cron is indistinguishable from a broken one when the cron misses a tick.

nodes.label: tracking/publish_filters.py — the live publishers' shared gate
nodes.norm_label: tracking/publish_filters.py — the live publishers' shared gate
nodes.rationale: Live producers applied no paused/retired/VOID gate while the app did; min_prob/min_edge are deliberately NOT in the gate because nfl_live_prop's cut is EV applied server-side.

nodes.label: tracking/publish_keys.py — the lock_key identity
nodes.rationale: game_id:model_id[:player_id] collapsed a whole game's nfl_prop_market props onto one key (player_id NULL); a pick was gone, not delayed, because the ledger answers 'already announced' forever. pick_side stays OUT.

nodes.label: tracking/publish_lock.py — Postgres advisory lock around read -> post -> ledger
nodes.norm_label: tracking/publish_lock.py — postgres advisory lock around read -> post -> ledger
nodes.rationale: A duplicate is a delivery fault the ledger cannot see: two publishers (pollers every 30s, worker passes) read 'not yet posted' 252ms apart and both POSTed. A run that cannot take the lock returns 0.

nodes.label: push_sent ledger — UNIQUE(lock_key, kind), written only after the POST succeeded
nodes.norm_label: push_sent ledger — unique(lock_key, kind), written only after the post succeeded
nodes.rationale: The deliberate inversion of push_notifier: a failed webhook retries next pass; _post_embeds returns only the confirmed count.

nodes.label: VOID exclusion and v_discord_published
nodes.rationale: Both halves exclude condition_status='VOID'; Discord is the source of truth, so the app keeps a published VOID on the board and a lock the channel lacks is not an active Discord-led bet.

nodes.label: A BET decided on the corrected probability can fail the publishers' cut on the model's own
nodes.norm_label: a bet decided on the corrected probability can fail the publishers' cut on the model's own
nodes.rationale: The scorer decides on model_probability_cal; the app, Discord and push filter on model_probability. Ten of eleven NHL BETs were written and shown nowhere.

nodes.label: Two publishers can post the same pick twice
nodes.norm_label: two publishers can post the same pick twice
nodes.rationale: push_sent is written after the POST so it cannot stop a second in-flight POST; fix is an advisory lock around the publish sequence with every caller through one helper.

nodes.label: A voided posted pick gives members no sign it was withdrawn
nodes.norm_label: a voided posted pick gives members no sign it was withdrawn
nodes.rationale: Discord gets a separate gray notice; the phone push has no follow-up; the app drops the card once a discord_void row exists.

nodes.label: One board — the app, Discord and push publish the same set
nodes.norm_label: one board — the app, discord and push publish the same set
nodes.rationale: Both producers read picks through model_action_thresholds, the same cut as passesActionFilter. Reading the capture table put a gate the app lacks in front of the channel; capture can only LOSE rows. No date horizon; the first BET wins; started-game guard stays.

nodes.label: A per-game notify is O(games), and a one-game slate hides it
nodes.norm_label: a per-game notify is o(games), and a one-game slate hides it
nodes.rationale: 60 simultaneous NCAAF games at 10s was ~100 fresh handshakes a tick; now one connection per pass and one notify after the loop.

nodes.label: A pick post shows game, start time, odds and unit stake only
nodes.norm_label: a pick post shows game, start time, odds and unit stake only
nodes.rationale: Model probability, edge and book are the model's IP; a test asserts the payload never leaks them.

nodes.label: The recap only covers a day that is OVER
nodes.norm_label: the recap only covers a day that is over
nodes.rationale: --step settle runs every refresh pass against today; without the guard a partial mid-slate record would post and be ledgered and the real recap could never fire. A later settlement restates it.

nodes.label: RETIREMENT NEEDS NO LIST
nodes.rationale: threshold_sync prunes model_action_thresholds to config.ACTION_THRESHOLDS, so a retired model has no row; requiring one is exactly the app's isModelRetired.

nodes.label: A trigger set is only as good as the events it does not miss (floor fetch)
nodes.norm_label: a trigger set is only as good as the events it does not miss (floor fetch)
nodes.rationale: A live total moves on every baserunner, not only runs and half-innings; DK snapshots landed every 269s against a 300s bound that could never bite. Floor fetch + tighter bound + bigger cap only work together.

nodes.label: stripe-webhook Edge Function (signature over raw body)
nodes.norm_label: stripe-webhook edge function (signature over raw body)

nodes.label: synced_bets table (raw betSlip stored whole)
nodes.rationale: A SharpSports field rename is a localized fix in pullAndUpsert because every slip is stored whole in synced_bets.raw.

nodes.label: verify_jwt per function
nodes.rationale: Webhooks from third parties carry no Supabase JWT, so they deploy --no-verify-jwt and authenticate by secret, signature or HMAC instead.

nodes.label: Session-only scope: no account-scoped data yet
nodes.norm_label: session-only scope: no account-scoped data yet
nodes.rationale: Signing in owns nothing but the session; bankroll, custom models, parlays, tracked bets stay device-local, and UI copy makes no cross-device sync promise until that lands.

nodes.label: Deno resolves relative imports at deploy time
nodes.norm_label: deno resolves relative imports at deploy time
nodes.rationale: A change to either _shared file requires redeploying every function that imports it.

nodes.label: CFBD_MONTHLY_CALL_ALLOWANCE (Tier 4, 125k)
nodes.rationale: A test asserts the cadence fits the plan, so lowering the poll without raising the plan fails a test rather than the feed.

nodes.label: Worker cannot reach site.api.espn.com (403); CFBD /scoreboard is the state source
nodes.norm_label: worker cannot reach site.api.espn.com (403); cfbd /scoreboard is the state source
nodes.rationale: Reduced field set degrades to NaN which LightGBM routes natively; serving artifacts (~1.2MB) are committed so the worker checkout can serve.

nodes.label: ncaaf_live.gameday loop
nodes.rationale: Exits itself ~30 minutes after the last game ends; picks are delete-and-replaced per pass and whatever stands at game end settles (the MLB live convention).

nodes.label: Gate 1: win probability Brier 0.115 PASS vs 0.20
nodes.norm_label: gate 1: win probability brier 0.115 pass vs 0.20
nodes.rationale: Held-out 2025; CFB is easier than the NFL here because blowouts are common. Every derived moneyline probability is licensed by this.

nodes.label: Gate 2: total shape 2.60pp FAIL vs 2.0pp
nodes.rationale: The median is calibrated to -0.04pp and early-game states pass; what fails is symmetric tail width plus the final two minutes (8.84pp).

nodes.label: Market licenses from the calibration gates
nodes.norm_label: market licenses from the calibration gates
nodes.rationale: Licensed: moneyline probabilities, main total early/mid-game and halftime. Not licensed: alternate lines, team totals, quarter markets, anything off the tails, and all pricing inside the final two minutes.

nodes.label: LIVE_ODDS_MAX_AGE_SEC (180s) odds age bound
nodes.rationale: Past the bound the feed reports NO odds rather than a line that stopped refreshing, so losing the feed fails safe instead of pricing a frozen number.

nodes.label: ncaaf_live_loop scheduler job (*/10 supervisor)
nodes.rationale: Supervisor relaunches gameday whenever it is not running; idle ticks cost one CFBD call and zero Odds API credits. Kill switch RUN_NCAAF_LIVE=0.

nodes.label: NCAAF live model (port of nfl/live_model)
nodes.rationale: Standalone package on purpose: nfl/ has internal models/ and scripts/ dirs that shadow the platform's the moment it lands on sys.path.

nodes.label: Stale-line cap: |edge| > 25% declined
nodes.rationale: A probably suspended/stale price is the classic in-play way to lose.

nodes.label: site.api.espn.com returns 403 to the Railway worker; sports.core first
nodes.norm_label: site.api.espn.com returns 403 to the railway worker; sports.core first
nodes.rationale: The feed tries sports.core first and falls back to site.api, the reverse of the platform's WNBA ingestor which was written while site.api still worked.

nodes.label: CFBD is metered: idle cadence dominates the bill
nodes.norm_label: cfbd is metered: idle cadence dominates the bill
nodes.rationale: State and odds poll on separate clocks because one is free and one is billed. Without idle backoff and early exit the idle burn alone was ~120k/month, 96% of the plan before a game kicks off; with them 5s costs ~60k realistic, ~77k busy November.

nodes.label: Two-season Stage 2 window + all-history (mu,time) backoff
nodes.rationale: Mu-only pmf pooled across all clock states is structurally wrong for a nearly deterministic endgame; thin recent cells fall back to the all-history (mu, time) cell first, keeping clock conditioning.

nodes.label: The edge question (phase 3) is unanswered and senior
nodes.norm_label: the edge question (phase 3) is unanswered and senior
nodes.rationale: Calibration says the engine describes football; it says nothing about whether any book is slow enough to be worth betting.

nodes.label: Era drift in distribution shape
nodes.rationale: At a fixed predicted mean, older seasons' outcome distributions are wider than modern ones; fitting Stage 2 on the two most recent seasons took 2024 coverage from 4.39pp to 2.76pp, monotone in recency, while smoothing variants moved nothing.

nodes.label: 2025 holdout consulted three times, recorded
nodes.rationale: 17 configurations examined on a 2024 pseudo-holdout is the multiple-comparisons budget disclosed; any future 2025 run is a fourth consultation.

nodes.label: OT states drop from training; OT points stay in targets
nodes.norm_label: ot states drop from training; ot points stay in targets
nodes.rationale: Markets settle including OT; CFB OT is alternating untimed possessions so the engine declines to price in-OT games.

nodes.label: Platform join by wallclock date, not week
nodes.norm_label: platform join by wallclock date, not week
nodes.rationale: games has no season_type and postseason weeks restart at 1, so a week-1 meeting and a bowl rematch collide.

nodes.label: Score-convention gate caught CFBD playNumber ordering corruption
nodes.norm_label: score-convention gate caught cfbd playnumber ordering corruption
nodes.rationale: CFBD playNumber is a per-drive counter; sorting by it scrambles games. The detector read 82% and refused to build; true order is (driveId, playNumber) at 99.0%.

nodes.label: Tilt-serve tried and measured worse
nodes.rationale: Exponentially tilting one cell to the exact mu scored 3.95pp on 2024 vs the mixture's 2.76pp; the mixture's width compensates real within-cell heterogeneity. Recorded in _marginal's docstring so it is not re-invented.

nodes.label: Runline Threshold Sweep workflow
nodes.rationale: Re-derives the mlb_runline threshold on real DraftKings run-line prices via scripts.mlb_runline_sweep; read-only, prints the reachable prob range, the grid and a plateau-vs-peak verdict in the run log. 2026 is the ONLY season with real DK run-line prices (2019-2025 have the -1.5 line but no prices), so retrain with 2026 held out first; the 0.68/0.11 cut was 'carried over UNVALIDATED' at the 2026-07-04 swap.

nodes.label: analysis-and-thresholds.md — path-scoped rule file
nodes.rationale: Loads on models/**, scripts/**, tracking/threshold_review.py, live_calibration.py, model_calibration_agent.py. Split out 2026-09-03.

nodes.label: The analysis protocol — how a 'find an edge' request is worked
nodes.norm_label: the analysis protocol — how a 'find an edge' request is worked
nodes.rationale: mike 2026-09-20: a full day on NHL markets produced a literature review, a bug hunt and one re-measured model, with no backtest and 378,446 loaded skater rows unused, while a free archive of lines sat in the session's notes. Research means experiments against prices; reading is timeboxed orientation; the deliverable is a results table before any plumbing.

nodes.label: The evaluation rule (restated for cuts)
nodes.rationale: Stays in CLAUDE.md because analysis is routinely done in SQL without opening any file here.

nodes.label: Features are hypotheses, tested by removal (ablation)
nodes.norm_label: features are hypotheses, tested by removal (ablation)
nodes.rationale: Loaded-and-unused data is a finding against the analysis.

nodes.label: Results in units with the four numbers: bets, units, ROI with CI, CLV
nodes.norm_label: results in units with the four numbers: bets, units, roi with ci, clv
nodes.rationale: On every scored game, as a threshold neighbourhood, split early/late, walk-forward by season. 'No cut clears, here is the grid' is a complete answer.

nodes.label: In-sample is in-sample
nodes.rationale: Cuts swept on live picks regress forward; state which samples are trustworthy by volume.

nodes.label: The market grid first
nodes.rationale: One row per market the book offers with TARGET, INPUTS, PRICE SOURCE and BASELINE columns; an empty cell is a to-do; nothing is out of scope by silence.

nodes.label: The market is the baseline
nodes.rationale: Score every model against the no-vig market probability and the dumb baseline; AUC and log loss are diagnostics, the result is units and CLV at real prices.

nodes.label: Require a plateau, not a peak
nodes.norm_label: require a plateau, not a peak
nodes.rationale: A cell whose eight neighbours flip negative one step away is noise; report neighbourhood, per-season split, bet count and CI; when negative everywhere, retrain instead of shipping the least-bad cut.

nodes.label: Plumbing is timeboxed and second
nodes.rationale: Bugs fixed first only when they corrupt the experiment; the day ends with the results table even if the pipeline is still broken.

nodes.label: A price source before a model
nodes.norm_label: a price source before a model
nodes.rationale: No prices means no profit claim; a source found in research is an input to use today. 'We have no lines' is sayable only after every §1b route has been tried and named.

nodes.label: A time split kills most false positives
nodes.norm_label: a time split kills most false positives
nodes.rationale: Every pooled situational edge in the NCAAF search collapsed when split early/late; make the split part of the method.

nodes.label: Validate the grading before moving a cut
nodes.norm_label: validate the grading before moving a cut
nodes.rationale: A sign bug in away-side spread grading turned a -20.6% cut into a phantom +15%.

nodes.label: Pre-game and in-play prices never mix
nodes.norm_label: pre-game and in-play prices never mix
nodes.rationale: In-play rows carry snapshot_type='in_play' and are excluded from pre-game scoring, training and closing-line math. The evening refresh keeps writing open rows after first pitch, so bound on snapshot_at <= commence_time.

nodes.label: Nothing is sent whose label disagrees with its side and line — pick_integrity.refuse_mismatched
nodes.norm_label: nothing is sent whose label disagrees with its side and line — pick_integrity.refuse_mismatched
nodes.rationale: Every producer supplies side and line or the pick is refused; a new surface adds itself to tests/test_pick_integrity.py and to the parity tests.

nodes.label: §7 The evaluation rule — evaluate every scored pick (BET, AVOID, NONE)
nodes.norm_label: §7 the evaluation rule — evaluate every scored pick (bet, avoid, none)
nodes.rationale: A BET-only sample only holds picks that cleared the live bar, so it is optimistic. mv_scored_pick_outcomes grades the whole universe. Coverage traps: NONE rows only from 2026-05-12, deleted ~2026-06-26 -> 2026-08-09, abs(edge) > MAX_EDGE_CAP gets no row. Clean windows 2026-05-12->06-25 and 2026-08-09->present.

nodes.label: A losing model is an assessment to run, not a model to pause
nodes.norm_label: a losing model is an assessment to run, not a model to pause
nodes.rationale: A pause banks the loss and ends the search. Full sweep first: every scored pick, grid as a neighbourhood, early/late split, bet count, CI, re-graded on the LIVE registry artifact. 'Should we unpause?' is never a question to ask. scripts/paused_model_assessment.py.

nodes.label: Quote a pick from its label, never rebuild its line
nodes.norm_label: quote a pick from its label, never rebuild its line
nodes.rationale: scored_line is the HOME number; a reply turned stored 'BUF +1' into 'Bills -1' and it was published (2026-09-12). State a pick with pick_label word for word; publishers refuse a pick whose label and fields disagree (tracking/pick_integrity.py).

nodes.label: §4 Results are always in units, never dollars
nodes.norm_label: §4 results are always in units, never dollars
nodes.rationale: One unit = one flat bet. A dollar figure invents a stake size nobody chose and cannot be compared. profit_flat is stored as dollars-per-$100 stake, so divide by 100. mike 2026-09-08.

nodes.label: scored_line is always the HOME number for spreads
nodes.norm_label: scored_line is always the home number for spreads
nodes.rationale: An away cover is (away - home) - scored_line > 0. Getting the sign wrong produced a wrong threshold twice (sessions 74 and 87); it flips every one-run game.

nodes.label: data-integrity.md — path-scoped rule file
nodes.rationale: Loads on data/**, models/**, tracking/**, monitoring/**. Every entry is a way a number can be wrong while looking right. Split out 2026-09-03.

nodes.label: A stat that is always NULL deletes the training matrix
nodes.norm_label: a stat that is always null deletes the training matrix
nodes.rationale: One sparse column plus dropna silently drops most rows; check population before adding a feature.

nodes.label: A self-healing backfill walking 'the oldest N un-done items' jams on items it can never do
nodes.norm_label: a self-healing backfill walking 'the oldest n un-done items' jams on items it can never do
nodes.rationale: Filter the queue by the same predicate the worker applies.

nodes.label: Gate the number that gets bet — use cal_error_actionable
nodes.norm_label: gate the number that gets bet — use cal_error_actionable
nodes.rationale: _mean_calibration_error averages bins unweighted across the whole range, diluting a 10pp error in the small band actually bet.

nodes.label: A feature that is constant in training is not a feature
nodes.norm_label: a feature that is constant in training is not a feature
nodes.rationale: XGBoost cannot split on it. Eight of mlb_f5_moneyline's 25 features were constant zero (home_win_pct, away_win_pct, d_run_differential), so it had no notion of team record. Check nunique per feature per season.

nodes.label: Use ET, never UTC, for 'today'
nodes.rationale: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) is tomorrow after 8pm ET; Python has the same trap.

nodes.label: innings_pitched 5.2 means five and two thirds
nodes.norm_label: innings_pitched 5.2 means five and two thirds
nodes.rationale: Baseball notation across all 135,010 rows; sum() inflates ERA by +0.025 mean bias, +0.002 once converted to outs. Convert once, work in outs.

nodes.label: Leakage hides in 'latest snapshot' — bound on snapshot_at <= commence_time and exclude in_play
nodes.norm_label: leakage hides in 'latest snapshot' — bound on snapshot_at <= commence_time and exclude in_play
nodes.rationale: 67% of completed 2026 WNBA games were featurized with a total that had drifted toward the final. Guards fail OPEN when a timestamp is missing so synthetic and SBR rows survive.

nodes.label: 'Today' is the wrong question for a live loop — use config.live_slate_dates()
nodes.norm_label: 'today' is the wrong question for a live loop — use config.live_slate_dates()
nodes.rationale: A game carries its first-pitch game_date, so a 10pm start is in the fourth inning under yesterday's date. Two outages, both silent because 'no active games' is what an empty slate looks like; the guard is a test, not a log line.

nodes.label: A missing feature at score time is not 0.0
nodes.norm_label: a missing feature at score time is not 0.0
nodes.rationale: Prop trainers drop incomplete rows so no prop model has seen a null; filling 0.0 hands trees a VALUE (a 0°F game priced two picks on 2026-09-10). models.scorer.prop_feature_matrix drops the row and logs; only PROP_IMPUTED_FEATURES are imputed, each with a reason.

nodes.label: Parse timestamps before comparing them
nodes.rationale: Columns are TEXT in mixed shapes (Z vs -04:00 vs naive); string comparison keeps leaked rows.

nodes.label: A pick stamped after its own first pitch is not a pre-game pick
nodes.norm_label: a pick stamped after its own first pitch is not a pre-game pick
nodes.rationale: CLV, line movement and opening-signal comparisons must bound on created_at <= commence_time; otherwise a stale number always reads as a favourable move and verdicts are nearly all positive.

nodes.label: The same leak can sit one table deeper and carry more
nodes.norm_label: the same leak can sit one table deeper and carry more
nodes.rationale: Fixing mlb_team_stats moved mlb_moneyline (AUC 0.529 -> 0.566) and left mlb_f5_moneyline flat because mlb_pitcher_stats held season-final ERA on every start (Nola's 33 rows for 2024 all 3.57) and d_starter_era features are 40% of importance. When a rebuild does not move a model, the leak is somewhere unlooked. Rebuilt 2026-09-03.

nodes.label: A model's probability is a separate claim from its point estimate and needs its own gate
nodes.norm_label: a model's probability is a separate claim from its point estimate and needs its own gate
nodes.rationale: Twelve models published probabilities 6-16pp above delivery at the levels bet, tracking sample size; a retrain moves the boundary not the behaviour. Fix is a claimed-to-realised map (models/probability_calibration.py). Since 2026-09-19 every model decides on it, with a shrunk one-parameter offset for thin records, and one EV floor on the calibrated number at the deciding price (config.min_ev_for). A writer skipping models/honest_ev.gate bets the raw number.

nodes.label: Season-to-date rates are noise early
nodes.rationale: Blend toward the prior season by games played; a raw average over the first month of a 12-game season is the biggest modelling error available.

nodes.label: A backfilled stats table can carry season-FINAL numbers under a season-START date
nodes.norm_label: a backfilled stats table can carry season-final numbers under a season-start date
nodes.rationale: mlb_team_stats had YYYY-01-01 and YYYY-10-01 rows both holding 162 games and final OPS/wRC+, so every historical training game knew how the season ended; AUC drops ~0.61 -> ~0.53 when the leak is gone. Check count(DISTINCT as_of_date) per season; two snapshots = none. docs/team_stats_leak.md.

nodes.label: Validate a replacement source against the thing you are replacing
nodes.norm_label: validate a replacement source against the thing you are replacing
nodes.rationale: A leaked table is a true record of the season finals, so rebuild a season from the new source and correlate: player_game_log scored 0.957/0.920/0.720 for 2023/24/25, degrading in step with coverage 87/81/74% — a faithful source with a hole, not a wrong one.

nodes.label: A health check must not gate on the thing that breaks
nodes.norm_label: a health check must not gate on the thing that breaks
nodes.rationale: Two checks reported SKIPPED for the entire outage they existed to catch because they keyed off data the failing feed produces.

nodes.label: No publishing surface gets a date horizon
nodes.norm_label: no publishing surface gets a date horizon
nodes.rationale: A pick is publishable when its game has not started, however far ahead it was written; the started-game check is the one guard that should bound the set. A LIVE surface resolves its window with config.live_slate_dates() mirrored by liveSlateDatesET(), pinned by tests/test_live_slate_midnight.py.

nodes.label: Early season rule — no picks until >= 10 games played
nodes.norm_label: early season rule — no picks until >= 10 games played
nodes.rationale: Season-to-date rates are noise early; blend toward the prior season by games played. NHL has no hold (mike 2026-10-01).

nodes.label: Every model carries its own EV floor — never ask whether
nodes.norm_label: every model carries its own ev floor — never ask whether
nodes.rationale: One GLOBAL_MIN_EV over 65 edge distributions removes models silently: at 0.20 it deleted every bet of mlb_spread_market and mlb_total_public_fade with no row to say so. No entry in config.MODEL_OWN_EV_FLOOR means add one, swept on its own record. mike 2026-09-20.

nodes.norm_label: batter prop models (hits, tb poisson; hr logistic retired)

nodes.rationale: Our state poller sees a run the instant it scores and DK's in-play total lags, so right after a scoring play the paired price predates the run and the edge is the run priced twice. Re-priced on the next DK snapshot the median edge collapses from +0.254 to +0.061.

nodes.label: Why Pinnacle gates
nodes.community_name: NFL game lines and wind totals docs
nodes.rationale: Before Pinnacle is up the best total is whichever soft book posted first, and the project was reversed once by exactly that selection. A live Pinnacle total is the cheapest check that a number is real. It gates, it does not price.

nodes.label: Process lesson: selection procedures preferentially sample corrupted records
nodes.community_name: NFL game lines and wind totals docs
nodes.norm_label: process lesson: selection procedures preferentially sample corrupted records
nodes.rationale: Three findings reversed by data quality (SBR column swap, SBR opener noise, sign flips); every analysis selecting on extremes must first run a per-source integrity screen.

nodes.label: Forecast debiasing has a sign trap
nodes.community_name: NFL game lines and wind totals docs
nodes.norm_label: forecast debiasing has a sign trap
nodes.rationale: E[forecast - truth | truth] says forecasts under-call high wind; E[truth | forecast], the only one applicable live, has the opposite sign because an extreme forecast is partly extreme noise. Selection thresholds the raw forecast because that is how the rule was validated.

nodes.label: Pinnacle gates; it does not price
nodes.community_name: NFL game lines and wind totals docs
nodes.norm_label: pinnacle gates; it does not price
nodes.rationale: Hold fire until Pinnacle quotes a total; selection and de-vig still run off the book being bet, exactly as validated. Pinnacle lives in the eu region so --regions us,eu costs 2 credits a tick.

nodes.label: One BET per pitcher plus interim daily cap
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.norm_label: one bet per pitcher plus interim daily cap
nodes.rationale: PROP_ONE_BET_PER_PLAYER collates the pitcher-prop pool to the highest claimed EV per (game, player); PROP_MAX_SIGNALS_PER_DAY holds pitcher_k and pitcher_hits to 3 each while their maps cannot be refit. A turned-away BET is written as NONE with downgrade_reason so a sweep does not read it as the model declining.

nodes.label: Nickname-aware settlement join
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.rationale: Joshua vs Josh Palmer graded NO_ACTION although he played; the fallback requires the same surname, a nickname or 3+ letter prefix match, and that the pick's spelling appears nowhere else in the stat log. An unguarded version mismatched 130 of 13,895 absences; the shipped one matches 0.

nodes.label: nfl_prop_market EV floor 0.20 -> 0.07
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.rationale: The 0.20 floor allowed 1 bet in three seasons of the model's own record, and a borrowed calibration offset pulled every probability to ~0.50 before EV was taken; the model wrote nothing after 2026-09-19. At 0.07 on its own probability the record is ~54 bets a season at +20.89%, every season positive. Shipped 2026-10-12 (#920).

nodes.label: MODEL_OWN_EV_FLOOR per model
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion

nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion

nodes.rationale: DECIDE_ON_CALIBRATED_PROB lived only in classify_edge; _make_prop_pick decided on the raw number, and all ten promoted maps were prop models, so the flag had never changed a production decision. 56 of 57 map-live prop BETs would not exist on the calibrated number. Fixed 2026-09-07.

nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.norm_label: props beat the close while losing
nodes.rationale: All three pitcher props have positive mean CLV; the models pick the right side at the right market and then price their confidence 14-17pp hot. That is a calibration problem, not a selection problem, and an argument against pausing them.

nodes.label: A promoted map could silently go inert
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.norm_label: a promoted map could silently go inert
nodes.rationale: load_calibrations kept only rows whose candidate method was platt, so a failed weekly refit (method NULL) dropped the promoted map on the next read. Fixed by reading promoted_method; promote() now requires helps AND transfers; demote() added.

nodes.label: Per-model EV depth of 2 for pitcher props
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.norm_label: per-model ev depth of 2 for pitcher props
nodes.rationale: An EV floor has no plateau (marginal buckets alternate sign) but a per-model top-2 depth maximises both units and ROI; a uniform 2 gives up ~2u in-sample to avoid fitting three depths to n=14/23/44.

nodes.label: One row per pick (uq_picks_one_row_per_pick)
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.rationale: Both pick locks asked for result IS NULL, so a doubleheader under one game_id let settlement release the lock every pass; 15% of the published record was copies. Locks now key on existence, prop scorers skip games with a final score, a unique index keyed without scored_line backs it, and dedupe_picks removed 69 rows.

nodes.label: Prior-dominated calibration offset on 23 picks
nodes.community_name: Pregame pick scorer and bet insertion
nodes.rationale: model_calibration held a = 1, b = -0.28 fitted on 23 graded picks and mostly the pooled offset from other models, promoted with promoted_helps=false 78 minutes after the model's last BET; the same situation that put wind, opener and NHL blocked shots into MODELS_ON_OWN_PROBABILITY.

nodes.label: Product rules that override any design opinion
nodes.norm_label: product rules that override any design opinion
nodes.rationale: A pick is a pick (§1c): line movement shown beside the locked number. Decided at best bettable price (§6): edge/badge/stake/P&L computed at decision_* via lib/decisionPrice.ts; a chip labelled with one book never carries another's betslip link; parlays priced at DraftKings. Every model is live real money (§2). Access is useEntitlement() never useSubscription().entitled (§6). Today is ET via todayET(). A native module needs a TestFlight build, not an OTA.

nodes.label: Access is decided in one place: public.my_access(), not the subscriptions table
nodes.norm_label: access is decided in one place: public.my_access(), not the subscriptions table
nodes.rationale: A Whop/Discord membership entitles the app and vice versa, so subscriptions holds half the answer. useEntitlement() in the app; gating on useSubscription().entitled charges a Discord member twice. Each side revokes only the Discord role it granted.

nodes.label: A pick is decided, sized and settled at the best bettable price, and the row says which
nodes.norm_label: a pick is decided, sized and settled at the best bettable price, and the row says which
nodes.rationale: mike 2026-09-09 'remove DK only'; in-play joined 2026-09-10. Stored as picks.decision_book/odds/implied_prob/edge; every reader uses COALESCE(decision_x, dk_x) since pre-09-09 rows were decided at DK. DraftKings stays the feature reference. CLV grades the price taken against that book's raw close; Pinnacle no-vig close is the market-edge column, never substituted. One code path per model: scorer._decide/_size, live_scorer.classify_live_signal, ncaaf_live.serve.LiveEngine._decide; stale-line cap always on the DK edge. nfl_live_prop stays DK-only.

nodes.norm_label: picks.profit_flat fabricates -110 for any pick with no price
nodes.rationale: A win with NULL odds is stored as +$90.91 on $100, exactly the -110 payout, so every read of profit_flat must be gated on dk_odds IS NOT NULL. mv_scored_pick_outcomes.profit_units is correctly NULL. 261 affected BETs.

nodes.label: A player prop DraftKings does not list is scored off the first bettable book that does
nodes.norm_label: a player prop draftkings does not list is scored off the first bettable book that does
nodes.rationale: Book taken in BEST_LINE_BOOKMAKERS order, never by price, because the line is the proposition and choosing by number would choose the bet to suit the model. picks.line_book names it (NULL = DK) and dk_odds/dk_implied_prob/edge are NULL/0.0 by design. A new population: report separately by line_book. SCORE_OFF_ANY_BOOK_LINE=0 restores the old behaviour. MLB F5 totals/spreads are the game-market exception (DK feed returns none, measured 2026-09-15).

nodes.label: §3 Edge signal classification (BET / AVOID / dead zone)
nodes.norm_label: §3 edge signal classification (bet / avoid / dead zone)
nodes.rationale: edge = model_probability - DraftKings implied probability; >= +cut BET, <= -cut AVOID (informational), between is no signal. The cut is PER MODEL in config.MODEL_EDGE_THRESHOLDS / MODEL_PROB_THRESHOLDS; the module fallback is 0.10 and never reached.

nodes.norm_label: §2 project purpose — personal betting model targeting draftkings
nodes.rationale: Seven live sports: MLB, WNBA, NBA, NHL, UFC, NFL, NCAAF; GOLF retired 2026-09-08. Long-term goal: all major US sports with all player props.

nodes.label: Tenth-Kelly bet sizing
nodes.rationale: f = 0.10 x (model_prob - implied) / (1 - implied), capped at 5% of bankroll. Quarter-Kelly always hit the cap so every pick got the same flat bet; tenth keeps bets at 2-4% and lets edge drive the difference (2026-05-04). config.KELLY_MULTIPLIER is env-overridable.

nodes.label: Fetch brand assets workflow
nodes.rationale: Fetches the @signalbasepicks X avatar and banner into mobile/assets/brand and commits back. Exists because the sandbox cannot reach x.com, the worker can but the read-only Supabase MCP returns bytes as base64 that cannot survive retyping, and a runner has open egress AND can commit. Dispatch is refused to the Claude GitHub integration (403), so a session triggers it by pushing the file itself; GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never re-trigger, so it cannot loop. SHA-256s recorded by scripts/fetch_brand_avatar.py are verified.

nodes.label: Mobile TestFlight build workflow
nodes.rationale: workflow_dispatch-only so the TestFlight push is always deliberate and runner minutes bill only on demand (the build runs on EAS). Every run spends one iOS build from the EAS plan's monthly allowance; when exhausted EAS refuses after the archive uploads. Deleted in #221 and restored. Submit retries once for transient EAS failures; a GraphQL step pulls the real submission error.

nodes.label: Mobile OTA update (production) workflow
nodes.rationale: Fires on any merge to master touching mobile/** and ships JS/TS to installed builds via eas update --channel production. The previous OTA workflow (2026-07-02) was never dispatched and deleted, so every JS-only mobile merge from 2026-08-24 sat undelivered — a user saw 6 UFC look-ahead picks counted as signals after #226 had fixed it. A manual step that must be remembered after every merge does not happen. runtimeVersion policy appVersion means an OTA reaches only matching app.json versions.

nodes.label: monitor probe workflow
nodes.rationale: Reaches the live monitor dashboard (worker-production-229d.up.railway.app) from a runner because the sandbox's egress proxy answers 403 to CONNECT — a sandbox limit, not a system limit. Asserts /healthz is 200 unauthenticated, / is 401 without a token, and with MONITOR_TOKEN renders the page (views live/models/ops) and /api/snapshot; /api/meta does not exist. Fires on push of the file itself on claude/** branches.

nodes.label: Prune merged branches workflow
nodes.rationale: Sundays 09:17 ET (off the hour because :00 is where every scheduled job piles up) plus dispatch with dry_run default true. On 2026-09-03 the remote carried 315 branches, 209 fully merged. A workflow rather than a hand command because a cleanup that has to be remembered does not happen (mobile-ota.yml's lesson) and because branch deletion cannot be driven from a Claude Code sandbox (git push --delete refused at transport, GitHub MCP has no delete). Only refs under claude/ and consolidate/.

nodes.label: APScheduler drives scheduler.py
nodes.rationale: Cron triggers with a DST-aware America/New_York timezone for the always-on worker that replaced GitHub Actions crons.

nodes.label: Latest TestFlight build tracking issue
nodes.rationale: A single GitHub issue tagged <!-- mobile-testflight-build --> updated on success, build failure (quota vs other) and submit failure, with phone-readable next steps and the resubmit command.

nodes.label: Railway worker (scheduler.py)
nodes.rationale: Always-on cloud worker with open egress holding the production secrets; where the pipeline, refresh passes and live loops run. docs/cloud_worker.md.

nodes.label: Supabase — system of record
nodes.rationale: Holds picks, odds, model_action_thresholds, odds_api_quota; the MCP route reads it, never writes.
