nodes.rationale: Replaying the production decision over kept state shows gate 4 as a peak (neighbour gate 5 flips to -2.70u) and the best gate moves when the sample changes; the gate does not fix calibration. Not shipped. The replay is also unreproducible for 13 games because no live pick records its feature row or lambda.

nodes.label: mlb_live_total_runs (in-play total)
nodes.rationale: Claimed ~73% and delivered ~54%. The repair chain: expose the pre-game total as a feature, group the CV by game, and fit a negative-binomial tail. The 2026-09-08 artifact ships 13 features, NB1 alpha 1.272, actionable calibration error 0.0010, and -26% qualifying states with no threshold moved.

nodes.label: Negative-binomial (NB1) tail
nodes.rationale: With the leak gone the count is genuinely overdispersed (var/mean 2.15-2.41); NB1 wins the train NLL and prices the 0.70-0.80 band at -0.02 gap against Poisson's +0.05. _count_over_prob dispatches on the artifact's tail so Poisson-only artifacts are bit-identical, and an unknown family raises.

nodes.label: pregame_total_line feature (market anchor)
nodes.rationale: A live total is priced relative to the starting line, but the model never carried it: total_line was filled from whichever market the caller passed and both live paths passed h2h. A dedicated feature sourced from the totals market, with train/serve parity checked (60/60 identical), replaces six noisy season-to-date stats.

nodes.label: Honest MLB signal is ~0.55-0.56 AUC
nodes.rationale: Walk-forward on rebuilt tables: mlb_moneyline 0.559, f5 0.557, over_under 0.507 (0.486 in the only honest season). The leaked seasons advertised 0.60-0.64. Retrains hold out on 2026 at the walk-forward number, and both lean on d_run_differential and away_win_pct, features that were constant zero before the rebuild.

nodes.label: ncaaf_live_total 2025 in-play backtest
nodes.rationale: 32,304 candidates; the production cut (prob >= 0.66, ev >= 0.22) is +1.8% on 297 bets over ALL quotes but -3.4% on 280 FRESH quotes. The first half loses and the second half wins in both arms; overs carry the profit and unders lose.

nodes.label: CollegeFootballData (CFBD) as primary source
nodes.rationale: Free API with games, historical lines per provider, advanced stats, SP+/Elo/SRS ratings, talent composite, play-by-play and venues; sportsdataverse releases are the bulk fallback. The free-tier rate limit could not be verified from the sandbox.

nodes.label: ncaaf_spread / ncaaf_over_under / ncaaf_moneyline
nodes.rationale: Spread first, totals second, moneyline third behind a -250 price floor because blowout moneylines are unbettable. Binary XGBoost plus Platt, so trainer.py needs no changes; bowls excluded from training and not bet; FBS-vs-FBS only.

nodes.label: Halftime second-half lines, out of sample at real prices
nodes.norm_label: halftime second-half lines, out of sample at real prices
nodes.rationale: Bought 2023-25 halftime 2H spreads and totals (59,129 credits): none of 9 frozen rules survives Benjamini-Hochberg, real 2H lines carry ~-115 both sides so break-even is 53.5%, and the first-half over-reaction (+0.058 points per point of surprise) is smaller than the vig.

nodes.label: Model state assessment, all 71 models (2026-09-03 snapshot)
nodes.norm_label: model state assessment, all 71 models (2026-09-03 snapshot)
nodes.rationale: Written the day the historical team-stats leaks were repaired; a dated snapshot, not a dashboard. 71 registered: 43 active, 24 paused, 4 retired; 33 never fired.

nodes.label: NCAA Football model build plan
nodes.rationale: Proposed plan for ncaaf_spread, ncaaf_over_under and ncaaf_moneyline: the first new sport where a free source ships real historical closing lines, so all three markets are backtestable against real prices on day one.

nodes.label: NCAAF model search findings (2026-08-25)
nodes.rationale: Once a look-ahead leak is controlled, no model family, feature group or era beats the closing line: out-of-sample log loss sits at or above ln(2) and CLV is below 0.5 in every configuration. The kill line from the plan was not honestly cleared.

nodes.label: Plateau, not a peak
nodes.rationale: A threshold is only shippable when its neighbouring cells agree in sign; a lone positive cell in an otherwise negative grid is selection noise. Chosen greedily on 2023-24, a 6pp NFL cut returned -0.46% blind on 2025.

nodes.label: EV rank is inverted on the live total
nodes.norm_label: ev rank is inverted on the live total
nodes.rationale: Top-2 claimed-EV live bets per day lost in both halves (-20.2%) while rank 5+ won (+20.0%); the cheap-price population (-110 or longer) is the loser. A cap that keeps the highest-EV live picks would keep the losing ones, so the model runs unfiltered.

nodes.label: Grouped, time-ordered CV for play-row models
nodes.norm_label: grouped, time-ordered cv for play-row models
nodes.rationale: One game becomes ~64 play rows with the same label and a constant pre-game fingerprint; KFold(shuffle=True) put a game's own plays on both sides of every fold, so Optuna optimised toward memorisation (CV NLL 1.92 vs holdout 2.74). Sorting by game_id and splitting with TimeSeriesSplit closes the gap to 0.04.

nodes.label: Switched-off models account for most of the loss
nodes.norm_label: switched-off models account for most of the loss
nodes.rationale: Since 2026-07-01, models since paused or retired account for -75 of -89 units; the current in-play set is +2.10% and pre-game -5.28%. Quoting the platform-wide number as how we are doing is wrong in both directions.

nodes.label: Train/serve mismatch after the leak repair
nodes.norm_label: train/serve mismatch after the leak repair
nodes.rationale: Every artifact fitted before 2026-09-03 was trained on season-final stats stamped on every historical row and is now served genuine as-of series. A rebuild is only finished for a model once that model has been retrained; NBA and NHL must be before October.

nodes.label: Prob x EV grid read as a neighbourhood
nodes.norm_label: prob x ev grid read as a neighbourhood
nodes.rationale: Every grid cell is printed with bets, units, ROI and a confidence interval so the reader can see whether a cut sits on a plateau or a spike; the 0.68 row looks best on the total and is surrounded by weaker cells.

nodes.label: game_tier feature (P4 / G5 / mixed)
nodes.rationale: Market efficiency is bimodal: a P4 primetime game is priced like the NFL while a midweek G5 game has a soft number; carry a tier feature and tune thresholds per tier.

nodes.label: Pre-committed kill criterion
nodes.rationale: If no prob x edge cell clears +3% flat ROI over >= 150 backtest bets on either spread or totals in the 2025 holdout, the sport does not ship. A null on ~800 games is trustworthy.

nodes.label: Preseason prior shrinkage: w = g/(g+k)
nodes.rationale: A 12-game season never stabilises team stats, and the >= 10 games early-season rule would blank 80% of the season; blend the in-season estimate with a prior-year SP+/returning-production prior weighted by games played. The single most important design decision in the build.

nodes.label: CLV below 0.5 in every configuration
nodes.rationale: CLV does not depend on where thresholds are cut or which season ran hot; if any model had predictive content some configuration would beat the close. None does (0.411-0.479).

nodes.label: FCS opponents pooled as one pseudo-team
nodes.norm_label: fcs opponents pooled as one pseudo-team
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered FCS games inflated home-field advantage to ~6.9 points because home partly encoded talent mismatch; pooling FCS into one team gives +3.7-3.9 points and removes artefacts.

nodes.label: Memorisation without generalisation
nodes.rationale: An unregularised fit scores below ln(2) in-sample and above it on 2025; relaxing the penalty produces spread but worse loss, so the null is real and not over-shrinkage.

nodes.label: ncaaf_team_stats postseason look-ahead leak
nodes.rationale: CFBD restarts week numbering for the postseason (every bowl is week=1), so selecting completed games with week < wk admitted the entire postseason into every in-season snapshot; 32.7% of snapshots carried future games. Fixed by filtering on date, not week; post-fix rate is 0.0000 in every season.

nodes.label: Benjamini-Hochberg multiplicity control
nodes.rationale: With hundreds of cells across rules, cuts and seasons, a few will clear 5% by chance; a family-wise correction is applied before any cell is called a result (0 of 297 game-line cells, 0 of 132 in-play cells, 0 of 60 pooled clean cells survive).

nodes.label: The protocol for every test
nodes.rationale: Construction fixed first; parameters fit on earlier seasons and the hold-out read once; grading at real bettable prices; a placebo for each; the grid reported as a neighbourhood; every season shown; intervals bootstrapped by game; multiplicity counted. Two independent verifiers attack every result.

nodes.label: A two-week sample does not overrule three seasons
nodes.norm_label: a two-week sample does not overrule three seasons
nodes.rationale: The 2026 over curve is non-monotone (4pp +14.4%, 5pp -18.6%, 6pp +1.7% on 4 bets) and the under is not the stronger side at the shipped cut, both the opposite of 2023-25, but every cell is under the 25-bet / plateau / time-split bar.

nodes.label: Pre-registered bars and kill criterion
nodes.rationale: Positive in each graded season; 90% CI excluding zero at a cut with >= 200 bets and positive neighbours; a pooled-normal placebo that does not reproduce the edge; selections not > 70% one direction; CLV on the median bet. If bars 1-3 fail at every cut the line of work closes.

nodes.label: Next Gen Stats subset leak
nodes.rationale: Merging the current week's NGS file gave +12% to +45% for every feature in both quartiles, because the file only has a row for a player who saw enough targets that week, so its presence reveals the outcome. Rebuilt as an as-of join, presence grades -5% to -15%. Ask why both quartiles won.

nodes.label: data/ingestors/nhl_derivative_odds_history
nodes.rationale: No credit cap (Michael 2026-10-03); a re-run buys nothing already stored (odds.source = odds_api_nhl_totals_history / nhl_derivative_odds_pulls).

nodes.label: DraftKings de-vigged price sits above realised over-rate
nodes.norm_label: draftkings de-vigged price sits above realised over-rate
nodes.rationale: Against reality three models are near-perfectly calibrated while DK's de-vigged price sits 2.4-8.1pp above the realised over-rate on nearly every market; the book carries a real over-lean.

nodes.label: Anytime goalscorer: not a candidate once names corrected
nodes.norm_label: anytime goalscorer: not a candidate once names corrected

nodes.label: nhl_moneyline and nhl_moneyline_regulation: no cut clears
nodes.norm_label: nhl_moneyline and nhl_moneyline_regulation: no cut clears
nodes.rationale: Moneyline log loss 0.6884 vs DK no-vig 0.6836; regulation fires on 18% of games vs 3.5% in backtest because it locks the first qualifying quote up to 72h out. Both stay live (mike, 2026-10-01).

nodes.label: Name-key matching attached prices to both namesakes
nodes.norm_label: name-key matching attached prices to both namesakes
nodes.rationale: Elias Pettersson (two Vancouver players) and Sebastian Aho; the backtest bet the better EV and graded one player's under on the other's count: 124 bets at 90% win, +89.8 units. The live card already refused shared names; backtests now do too.

nodes.label: The overnight pass takes the night's slots
nodes.norm_label: the overnight pass takes the night's slots
nodes.rationale: The 00:18 ET pass sees only Hard Rock shots/assists; saves and blocked shots post ~70 min before puck drop, so first-come caps fill before the better markets post.

nodes.label: Team-total under flips sign between regulation and full-game goals
nodes.norm_label: team-total under flips sign between regulation and full-game goals
nodes.rationale: FanDuel team-total under is +2.30% on regulation goals and -4.42% on full-game goals; DK's current settlement rule is unverified, so a side that wins on only one settlement is not publishable.

nodes.label: Anytime scorer at the best book: not trusted
nodes.norm_label: anytime scorer at the best book: not trusted

nodes.label: The borrowed probability correction (promoted_b -0.259947)
nodes.rationale: A model with no record is handed a downward shift fitted on other models' favoured sides, applied as 1-f(1-p) below 50%; it makes nhl_moneyline bet only underdogs, sums the regulation model's three outcomes to 1.144, and turns blocked-shot unders from +6% to -4%. Models decide on their own probability instead.

nodes.label: Coherent-quote filter: drop two-way rows summing outside 1.00..1.15
nodes.norm_label: coherent-quote filter: drop two-way rows summing outside 1.00..1.15
nodes.rationale: The shared prop parser paired an over from one FanDuel line with an under from another; before the filter the 2023-24 best-book shots row read +31.1%, after it -0.9%.

nodes.label: Early-weeks hold refuted by backtest
nodes.rationale: Over five seasons the live inputs do no worse early than in the rest of the season; the blended input list is worse everywhere it can be compared; nothing switched.

nodes.label: First-week inputs: last season's totals and league-average goalies
nodes.norm_label: first-week inputs: last season's totals and league-average goalies

nodes.label: The live artifacts graded on 2025-26 (scripts/nhl_live_artifact_grade)
nodes.rationale: Neither live model made money on the unseen season; every raw-edge grid row is negative; CLV at loose cuts is no better than blind away/underdog.

nodes.label: nhl_prop_assists
nodes.rationale: +10.9% on 1,063, return RISES with the cut; loses at every cut under the borrowed correction so it must decide on its own number. Unders only.

nodes.label: nhl_prop_blocked_shots (models/nhl_prop_blocked_shots.py)
nodes.rationale: Blocked-shot unders at DraftKings: plateau 0.03-0.12, every season positive; chosen floor EV>=0.10 (+6.2% on 2,054). Pinnacle does not quote the market, so there is no sharp line to be wrong against.

nodes.label: nhl_prop_saves
nodes.rationale: +7.8% on 1,755 bets, survives the borrowed correction; three extra inputs (home, goalie rest, both teams' rest) chosen on count deviance not return. A goalie who did not start is NO_ACTION.

nodes.label: nhl_prop_shots_on_goal
nodes.rationale: +5.7% on 4,707 at the best price; at DraftKings alone +3.3% with +0.3% in 2024-25 — the best price is the difference between a model and no model. Volume 8.9 bets a day.

nodes.label: Regulation 3-way: blind draw +6.9% is one overtime-heavy season
nodes.norm_label: regulation 3-way: blind draw +6.9% is one overtime-heavy season

nodes.label: Round one: repo features, no cut clears on moneyline or totals
nodes.norm_label: round one: repo features, no cut clears on moneyline or totals
nodes.rationale: Model log loss 0.702 is worse than the market open 0.656 and worse than quoting the home-win rate 0.690, so its 'edges' are its own error.

nodes.label: Round three: the moneyline candidate did not replicate
nodes.norm_label: round three: the moneyline candidate did not replicate
nodes.rationale: +3.0% on 1,268 unseen bets with a CI roughly -2.5..+8.5, one season negative; what held is CLV (beat Pinnacle's close 61-67%). Puck line is a peak not a plateau.

nodes.label: Round two: regularised logistic moneyline candidate
nodes.norm_label: round two: regularised logistic moneyline candidate
nodes.rationale: First positive grid in the NHL work (+8.0% at edge 0.06) but two of four seasons carry it and accuracy only matches the market open; frozen as a candidate for unseen seasons, not a model to bet.

nodes.label: Total goals: margin on both sides, nhl_over_under stays untrained
nodes.norm_label: total goals: margin on both sides, nhl_over_under stays untrained
nodes.rationale: A perfect predictor of line movement would earn less than the prop models; what would have to change is the market, not the model.

nodes.label: Underdogs vs favourites, six seasons (scripts/nhl_underdog_grid)
nodes.rationale: Blind underdogs lost in five of six seasons at every price (-6.9% at DK open vs -2.2% favourites); the published 1990s underdog bias is gone in later work.

nodes.label: NHL stats API, MoneyPuck, Daily Faceoff and other sources
nodes.norm_label: nhl stats api, moneypuck, daily faceoff and other sources

nodes.label: DraftKings NHL settlement rules
nodes.rationale: Moneyline, puck line, total include OT and shootout; skater props void only if the player does not dress; goalie props void if the goalie does not start.

nodes.label: Three goalie inputs were season-final (leaked)
nodes.rationale: Goalie save%, GAA, GSAA dated YYYY-10-01 held the season's FINAL line; walk-forward AUC 0.605 with them, 0.582 without. Team rates were prior-season finals: stale but honest.

nodes.label: Historical NHL odds: game lines from 2020-21, props and 3-way from 2023-05-03
nodes.norm_label: historical nhl odds: game lines from 2020-21, props and 3-way from 2023-05-03

nodes.label: The NHL moneyline close is efficient (four null results)
nodes.norm_label: the nhl moneyline close is efficient (four null results)
nodes.rationale: Robbins 2023, Lahtinen 2019, Lopez et al. 2018, Hockey-Statistics 2024; the best public models roughly match the Pinnacle close and none has a record of beating it.

nodes.label: Six NHL pipeline defects found 2026-09-20
nodes.rationale: Invented team ids (CAN/BLU), season label split in September, every probable goalie sharing one goalie's numbers, GSAA = GAA, the undocumented h2h_3way key, 2025-26 missing from games.

nodes.label: Retrain 2026-09-20: honest, calibrated, barely above base rates
nodes.norm_label: retrain 2026-09-20: honest, calibrated, barely above base rates

nodes.label: player_news table: player_id plus player_key
nodes.rationale: Both keys on every row: an exact-string join on player_name once cost ~9% of every MLB slate its prop prices; a name two players share resolves to NO id rather than the wrong one.

nodes.label: Recent News sheet on prop player screens
nodes.norm_label: recent news sheet on prop player screens
nodes.rationale: A player prop is a bet on ONE person and what moves it most often is a sentence, not a number.

nodes.label: NHL models CLV and EV assessment (2026-10-08)
nodes.norm_label: nhl models clv and ev assessment (2026-10-08)

nodes.label: NHL derivative totals: team, alternate, first period
nodes.norm_label: nhl derivative totals: team, alternate, first period

nodes.label: CLV graded at the price taken, close Pinnacle-first
nodes.norm_label: clv graded at the price taken, close pinnacle-first
nodes.rationale: 17 of 23 regulation bets were graded at DK's price when decided elsewhere; 30 Hard Rock picks got no CLV at all because capture filtered on dk_odds. 216 rows re-graded once.

nodes.label: CLV-only final prop snapshot 25-12 min before start
nodes.norm_label: clv-only final prop snapshot 25-12 min before start
nodes.rationale: Saves and blocked shots are posted only ~70 minutes out, so the decision snapshot IS the close and CLV is zero by construction; a third snapshot filed as snapshot_type close fixes it for ~6,600 credits a season.

nodes.label: NHL props: four bets a night, not two
nodes.norm_label: nhl props: four bets a night, not two
nodes.rationale: On the corrected backtest +54.6 units a season vs +38.8; on books posting live +56.8 vs +35.5, the same as no nightly limit; every season positive. One a game and the 0.18 floor stay.

nodes.label: Units a season is the quantity EV is maximised on
nodes.norm_label: units a season is the quantity ev is maximised on
nodes.rationale: Return per bet is shown beside units a season, never instead of it; every looser nightly cap earns more units in every season.

nodes.label: Nothing cleared; PUBLISHED = ()
nodes.rationale: Three ids (nhl_team_total, nhl_alternate_total, nhl_p1_total) are in neither ACTION_THRESHOLDS nor PAUSED_MODELS; the card writes nothing.

nodes.label: Publishable: >=200 bets, >=2 seasons positive, both halves, interval above zero
nodes.norm_label: publishable: >=200 bets, >=2 seasons positive, both halves, interval above zero
nodes.rationale: The 0.10 cut is a rule only when 0.08 and 0.12 clear the same way — a plateau, not a peak.

nodes.label: DraftKings' margin sits on the OVER; selective unders are the structure
nodes.norm_label: draftkings' margin sits on the over; selective unders are the structure
nodes.rationale: Blind overs lose 6-13% in every NHL count market, blind unders 1-6%; a model that says WHICH unders has something to work with. The full-game total has margin on both sides and no cheap side.

nodes.label: At most 3 shots-on-goal bets a game
nodes.norm_label: at most 3 shots-on-goal bets a game
nodes.rationale: A per-game cap is a plateau not a gain (N=3 +5.4% vs uncapped +5.7%); heavy nights (>30% of board) returned -13.8%, so the cap bounds a night like 2026-10-01's 17 picks without buying return.

nodes.label: Sharp-vs-soft quotes must come from one snapshot
nodes.norm_label: sharp-vs-soft quotes must come from one snapshot
nodes.rationale: Comparing each book's FIRST stored quote with Pinnacle's FIRST mixed moments; a soft book's stale number against a later Pinnacle number is a bet nobody could place. Forced within five minutes the rule finds 96 bets and no edge.

nodes.label: Unders only, best bettable price, FanDuel excluded
nodes.norm_label: unders only, best bettable price, fanduel excluded
nodes.rationale: Every blind over loses at DK; FanDuel is out because 2,556 of its shots rows fail the coherent-quote check and the filter can only drop the pairs it can see.

nodes.label: CLV must be the yardstick
nodes.rationale: SE of ROI ~ 1/sqrt(n): 95% confidence needs ~9,600 bets for a 2% edge; a season is 1,344 games, so ROI cannot confirm a realistic edge in one season and CLV can.

nodes.label: Proposed approach: measure first, three candidates
nodes.norm_label: proposed approach: measure first, three candidates
nodes.rationale: Fix the pipeline, buy the measuring stick (DK + Pinnacle lines), then sharp-vs-soft, an honest goals model, and market-anchored props (saves and shots first) graded on every scored game with CLV from the first pick.

nodes.label: ESPN call budget: one league feed, <=12 team feeds, max-age gate
nodes.norm_label: espn call budget: one league feed, <=12 team feeds, max-age gate
nodes.rationale: ESPN has IP-blocked the worker twice; the intraday step is gated on max age so ~42 passes a day cannot become 42 sweeps.

nodes.label: News provider is a setting, not a hard-code (ESPN default)
nodes.norm_label: news provider is a setting, not a hard-code (espn default)
nodes.rationale: RotoWire is licensed; ESPN is free, keyless and reuses the hidden API the injury ingestor reads, so the feature ships and is judged on usage before anyone signs a contract. Its limitation is coverage, not correctness.

nodes.label: ncaaf_live_win_prob 2025 in-play backtest
nodes.rationale: 27,920 candidates; the production cut is -8.8% on 56 bets (all quotes) and -13.1% on 51 (fresh). Calibration bands claim 0.72-0.78 and deliver 0.75-0.80 yet still lose at the posted price.

nodes.label: Cross-book opener signal (DK vs Bovada)
nodes.rationale: Where DraftKings' and Bovada's opening spreads disagree, bet the side Bovada favours at DK's number: +10.9% to +15.4%, positive in all three seasons, CLV 0.694, with both placebos (bet Bovada's open, bet DK's close) collapsing to zero. The reversed assignment is null. Status: candidate, not a model.

nodes.label: prune_odds keeps the earliest snapshot per proposition
nodes.norm_label: prune_odds keeps the earliest snapshot per proposition
nodes.rationale: The pruner previously kept only the newest snapshot so openers lived at most two days; it now keeps the first snapshot per (proposition, book) forever while discarding ~99.5% of redundant rows.

nodes.label: Late-game leader moneyline at DraftKings
nodes.rationale: <= 10 minutes left, lead 4-16, model win probability >= 2 points above DK's price: 2024 +15.8% on 87, 2025 +2.3% on 80, pooled +9.4% (90% CI +1.8, +16.8). Two seasons cannot rule out a +5% edge; power ~0.27. Marginal, not a model.

nodes.label: Fresh-quote filter (points_since_update == 0)
nodes.rationale: Restricting to quotes the book had just refreshed removes most of the apparent profit on the total (+5.41u to -9.50u), which says the all-quotes gain was stale-line capture rather than an edge.

nodes.label: Executability: are both openers observable at the same moment?
nodes.norm_label: executability: are both openers observable at the same moment?
nodes.rationale: CFBD ships no timestamps, so history cannot say whether Bovada's open embeds information DK's lacks; Bovada's opener sits ~40% of the way to the close, consistent with either a sharper number or a later capture. Resolved only forward with timestamped capture.

nodes.label: Cross-book latency is not a model
nodes.norm_label: cross-book latency is not a model
nodes.rationale: The only positive in-play cells come from the best of five books at one snapshot; graded at the median book they earn +1.1%. William Hill's moneyline was unchanged after a score in 19.8% of snapshots vs DK's 3-5%, and the gap closed by the next snapshot 60-71% of the time. Five-minute snapshots cannot show whether a stale quote was bettable.

nodes.label: Not stale-line capture
nodes.rationale: The second and third qualifying quotes (5-10 minutes later) return +9.7% and +11.7%, and quotes where the book had NOT moved return +23.7%; no decay, nothing races anybody.

nodes.label: The model predicts DK's own next line move, and it does not pay
nodes.norm_label: the model predicts dk's own next line move, and it does not pay
nodes.rationale: Correlation +0.66 on receptions between (projection - t72 line) and the game-day move, stable across seasons; but the mean captured move is +0.4 yards and betting the direction wins 51.8% where 53.5% is needed. The book reads the same public statistics a day later.

nodes.label: Opener: sharp-vs-soft deviation (bet Pinnacle's side at the soft book)
nodes.norm_label: opener: sharp-vs-soft deviation (bet pinnacle's side at the soft book)
nodes.rationale: +5.11pp excess over the line-implied cover rate at threshold 1.0, +6.82% at actual prices, CI touching zero; 70% of profit is 2024.

nodes.label: Early-week Opener signal (spreads only, not cleared)
nodes.norm_label: early-week opener signal (spreads only, not cleared)
nodes.rationale: Survives only on spreads: +5.11pp excess vs +0.98pp placebo; totals and h2h null on a dense scan (55,440 credits). Decays +4.75/+14.31/+1.05% by season; rests on one market in one season of three.

nodes.label: Books do not open at the same time; openers correct slowly
nodes.norm_label: books do not open at the same time; openers correct slowly
nodes.rationale: Soft/offshore books post ~11.7 days out, Pinnacle ~6.5; only 4.8% of initial error is corrected within a day, so capturing opener value needs presence in the window, not sub-second execution.

nodes.label: DraftKings-reference placebo is the decisive test
nodes.norm_label: draftkings-reference placebo is the decisive test
nodes.rationale: Spreads: +5.11pp vs +0.98pp placebo. Totals: the placebo tracks the signal (+4.46 vs +4.47 at 1.5), so the totals opener is a property of selecting on any large deviation, not Pinnacle's information.

nodes.label: Moneyline opener null
nodes.rationale: Non-monotone, every interval spans zero, sign flips twice; the moneyline is a monotone transform of the spread so the deviation carries the same information at higher hold.

nodes.label: Opener decays hard by season: one market in one of three seasons
nodes.norm_label: opener decays hard by season: one market in one of three seasons
nodes.rationale: Next test is 2026 out-of-sample, not a re-tuned threshold and not another market.

nodes.label: Totals opener does not exist (sampling artifact)
nodes.norm_label: totals opener does not exist (sampling artifact)
nodes.rationale: The sparse 488-snapshot subset read +4.80pp; the dense 1,874-snapshot grid (27,720 credits) reads +0.66pp [-3.0, +4.3].

nodes.norm_label: abuse guards in feedback_submit (4,000 chars, 20/hour, 25 open)

nodes.community_name: In-app feedback and anon access docs
nodes.rationale: The grant is the only thing stopping a client posting a message that renders as from us; revoking from PUBLIC is not enough, anon and authenticated must be revoked by name. If it ever appears in the advisor list, revoke immediately.

nodes.community_name: In-app feedback and anon access docs
nodes.rationale: One thread per conversation owned by a device_id; status open / answered / closed.

nodes.norm_label: anon grants and rls: the schema-wide sweep (anon_readable.py, apply_anon_grants.py)
nodes.rationale: 0 of 84 public tables with RLS off; a relation the app reads holds SELECT and nothing else unless in ANON_WRITABLE; TRUNCATE revoked everywhere. 'This needs a decision' was itself a claim to check.

nodes.label: In-app feedback — reading it and replying

nodes.label: Device-scoped SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, RLS on with no policies
nodes.community_name: In-app feedback and anon access docs
nodes.norm_label: device-scoped security definer rpcs, rls on with no policies
nodes.rationale: The app uses the anon key with no session, so a row policy has no identity to filter on; the per-install UUID acts as a bearer token, the same trust model as tracked_bets. Feedback is tied to a device, not a person.

nodes.label: ESPN core probables for the NHL starting goalie
nodes.norm_label: espn core probables for the nhl starting goalie
nodes.rationale: NHL /schedule/now carries no probableGoalie (43 games, 0 populated); ESPN core competitor probables does. Joined on displayName via NHL_ODDS_API_MAP, not ESPN_NHL_TEAM_IDS (collides).

nodes.label: A NONE from this gate is not locked — the reprice path
nodes.norm_label: a none from this gate is not locked — the reprice path
nodes.rationale: The game lock is BET-only, so the next pass that sees a new probable rebuilds features and may fire.

nodes.label: The gate rule — refuse a game-model BET on a confirmed Out starter/star/goalie
nodes.norm_label: the gate rule — refuse a game-model bet on a confirmed out starter/star/goalie
nodes.rationale: A gate, not a feature: ESPN statuses do not enter the XGB models or fudge injury_adj. _has_starter_out fires on any IL player with no position, the wrong shape for this product.

nodes.label: Fires in scorer.score_game and _score_nhl_3way, after best-price requalify, before insert
nodes.norm_label: fires in scorer.score_game and _score_nhl_3way, after best-price requalify, before insert
nodes.rationale: Not applied to NCAAF, UFC, nfl_opener_spread or nfl_wind_totals.

nodes.label: status_ts <= the quote's snapshot_at — news after the line is ignored
nodes.norm_label: status_ts <= the quote's snapshot_at — news after the line is ignored
nodes.rationale: The same timestamp discipline as nfl_prop_injury_veto; missing either clock fails open; AVOID and NONE rows are not rewritten.
